Method: 采用<em>因子实验设计</em>，覆盖5个软件工程任务（代码生成、技术债务识别、代码漏洞检测、日志解析、日志分析）×4种智能体配置（NA无智能体、SA单智能体、DA双智能体、MA四智能体）×6款开源LLM（Gemma3-4B、CodeGemma-7B、Qwen3-4B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B、DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B、GPT-OSS-20B）×3种硬件平台（Server-SMU 8×H100、Workstation-SMU RTX A2000、Server-STF 2×RTX 6000 Ada）×2种提示策略（零样本、少样本），多数实验重复3次，共1840次运行。通过AG2/AutoGen框架实现智能体编排，使用Ollama作为推理后端，CodeCarbon测量进程级能源消耗（CPU RAPL + GPU NVML + 内存），任务专用评估指标包括Pass@1、Macro F1、F1分数、解析准确率等。统计检验采用Friedman检验+Wilcoxon符号秩事后检验+匹配对秩双列相关系数效应量。

Result: 1）<strong>智能体配置的准确性效应</strong>：NA在5个任务中的4个（代码生成、技术债务、日志解析、日志分析）取得最高平均分，MA仅在漏洞检测中表现最优（F1=55.4% vs NA的49.7%）。2）<strong>能源与延迟的系统性成本</strong>：MA相比NA平均多消耗6.36倍能源、慢6.07倍，最坏情况下MA在Workstation-SMU上运行日志解析达50186秒（NA仅313秒，慢160倍）。3）<strong>Pareto前沿分析</strong>：15个任务-硬件对共66个Pareto最优配置，其中36个为NA（55%）、23个为SA（35%）、6个为DA（9%）、仅1个为MA（2%）。4）<strong>模型效应</strong>：无单一模型在所有任务中占优，G3-4B在代码生成最优，GPT-OSS在技术债务最优，Q3-4B在漏洞检测最优，Q2.5C-7B在日志任务最优；7B的CG-7B能耗低于4B模型，能耗与参数数量并非单调关系。5）<strong>提示策略效应</strong>：少样本提示使准确率从3.4%提升至54.3%（日志解析），同时能耗降低24-41%。6）<strong>硬件效应</strong>：对轻量配置硬件差异<3个百分点，对MA配置工作负载高端服务器比工作站快3.4倍。7）<strong>能耗-延迟强耦合</strong>：Pearson相关系数r=0.987（对数空间）。整个活动共消耗651.7 kWh电力，约110.8 kg CO₂e。

Conclusion: 论文提出五项可持续智能体LLM系统设计指南：G1）<em>从无智能体基线开始，仅在有证据证明任务特定价值时升级</em>；G2）<em>在调整架构前先匹配任务与模型</em>；G3）<em>对输出结构敏感的任务使用少样本提示</em>；G4）<em>根据工作负载而非原始性能选择硬件</em>；G5）<em>同时报告能耗与准确性</em>。核心结论是：增加智能体复杂性并不带来普遍的准确性收益，仅在特定任务（如漏洞检测）中有效，但其能源与延迟成本是系统性的；轻量级、任务感知的配置能够构建具有竞争力的LLB开发工具，而多智能体设计应仅在证明具有任务特定收益时采用。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering, including agentic systems that coordinate multiple agents, but impose higher computational and environmental costs. In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study of agentic LLM systems across five software engineering tasks: code generation, technical debt identification, code vulnerability detection, log parsing, and log analysis. For each task, we compare LLM configurations that range from a non-agentic single-query baseline to multi-agent workflows, using six open-weight LLMs, two prompt strategies, and three hardware platforms. We assess each configuration in terms of accuracy, inference latency, and energy consumption. Our results reveal substantial trade-offs between agentic complexity and energy efficiency: multi-agent designs consume on average 6.36$\times$ as much energy and run 6.07$\times$ as long as the non-agentic baseline, with worst-case slowdowns of up to 160$\times$ for individual task--hardware pairs. Accuracy gains from additional agents are limited and task-specific: multi-agent improves average vulnerability-detection accuracy, but lightweight non-agentic and single-agent configurations still dominate the Pareto front, accounting for 59 of 66 Pareto-optimal configurations. Model and prompt choice act as task-specific levers whose effective direction varies between tasks rather than as global defaults. We translate these findings into design guidelines for sustainable, task-aware LLM-based development tools.

</details>


### [225] [MintEval: Do LLMs Implement the Trading Strategy You Asked For? A Behavioural-Equivalence Benchmark for Natural-Language-to-Strategy Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03080)
*Siyu Wang,Yifan Wang,Yuecheng He*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文介绍MintEval，一个评估大语言模型能否将自然语言交易策略描述准确转化为可执行代码的行为等价性基准。该基准通过可组合的构建块程序化生成参考策略，反向翻译为交易员口语化指令，再让模型重新实现，并逐根K线对比行为而非代码相似度或利润。在800个BTCUSDT 15分钟数据任务上，低成本模型的ActionMatch最高仅0.544，Claude Opus 5.5前沿模型达0.889但仍有27.5%的任务静默失败；即使能正确理解规范，79.2%的实现在超过10%的活跃K线上偏离，而现有LLM法官接受了所有这些静默失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码基准测试单元测试的功能正确性，金融基准测试预测能力，但二者都不能衡量LLM生成的交易代码是否真正按照交易员描述的策略逻辑执行——这种"实施缺口"是静默的：代码能运行、回测能出图，但风险逻辑并非所描述的逻辑。这一问题在LLM从生成交易信号转向编写执行代码的角色转变中尤为关键。

Method: 方法包含四部分：(1) 任务定义：从6个信号、2个过滤器、3个仓位和9个风险模块的构建库中程序化生成参考策略，反向翻译为口语化交易员指令，让模型重新实现；(2) 行为等价性度量：ActionMatch（活跃K线动作匹配率）、TradeF1（完整往返交易匹配）、|ES|（初始权益基点差异）等，逐根K线在相同数据和摩擦下对比行为；(3) 双重复杂度轴：描述长度K与执行测量的状态跨度τ、寄存器数R几乎正交；(4) 开放设置（仅给指令和接口）与封闭诊断设置（给构建块菜单）分离理解与实现能力。物理因果性由引擎强制保证（禁止窥视未来）。

Result: 在800个任务上：低成本模型（GPT-5.4-mini、Claude Haiku）开放设置ActionMatch最高0.544，最多8.7%任务完全复现；Qwen2.5-Coder模型表现更差。Claude Opus 5.5在200任务子集上达ActionMatch 0.889、57.5%完全复现，但27.5%任务仍静默失败。关键发现：封闭设置下模型几乎完美识别策略（SpecMatch ~0.94），但规范完全正确的1767次编译运行中79.2%的ActionMatch低于0.9，说明瓶颈在于实现持久状态逻辑而非理解指令。状态跨度τ增加显著降低性能（开放设置每十倍-0.065 ActionMatch）。QuantCode-Bench的LLM法官接受了所有静默失败，而其负控制拒绝率100%，证明代码阅读法官无法识别"正确策略被错误实现"的情况。

Conclusion: MintEval揭示了LLM交易代码生成中一个被忽视的失败模式：模型可以正确理解自然语言策略描述，却在实现持久状态逻辑时产生静默偏离，使得代码运行、回测出图但执行逻辑并非所描述的逻辑。前沿模型缩小了差距但未消除问题。代码阅读式法官无法检测此类失败，因此需要执行层面的行为等价性度量。该基准为评估实施保真度提供了可控、可变机制的工具，v1版本将扩展数据资产、增加任务难度并引入其他模型家族的验证。

Abstract: Large language models are moving from producing trading signals to writing the code that executes them. The failure mode of the second role is silent: generated code runs, a backtest plots, yet the risk logic that the trader described is not the logic being executed. Existing code benchmarks test functional correctness on unit tests and finance benchmarks test forecasting; neither measures whether an implementation behaves like the strategy that was asked for. We introduce MintEval, a benchmark in which reference strategies are generated programmatically from a library of composable building blocks, back-translated into colloquial trader instructions, and re-implemented by the model under test. Generated and reference programs are executed bar by bar on identical market data and frictions, and compared on their actions rather than on code similarity or profit: alpha is differenced away. MintEval v0 contains 800 tasks on BTCUSDT 15-minute data, stratified by an execution-measured state-span complexity tau that is decoupled from description length. Low-cost models reach a mean ActionMatch of at most 0.544 and reproduce at most 0.087 of tasks exactly; on a stratified subset of 200 tasks a frontier model (Claude Opus 5.5) reaches 0.889 and reproduces 0.575 exactly, yet still fails silently on 0.275 of tasks. Given a menu of building blocks, models identify the strategy almost perfectly, yet 79.2% of the implementations whose specification was read correctly diverge on more than 10% of active bars. The LLM judge of a recent strategy-generation benchmark, applied verbatim, accepts every one of these silent failures.

</details>


### [226] [Pinning Decisions Before Failure: Executable Records of Underspecified Choices in AI-Assisted Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03237)
*Takeharu Mitsui*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"决策钉"(decision pin)机制，通过在自然语言需求中显式枚举未明确指定点、为每个点构造两个仅在该点上不同的示例实现并找出能区分二者的"分离输入"，再由人选择其中一个结果，从而将隐式选择变为可记录、可执行验证的显式决策。在40个任务基准测试中，92.5%的决策点获得了分离输入，85-90%获得决策钉；作为703个独立生成实现的检查手段，与基准分类一致性达96-97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言需求往往存在歧义/未明确指定之处，模型在生成实现时会"静默地"填补这些空白，导致42.7%（基于600个生成测试套件、3个模型统计）的测试套件没有任何测试能区分竞争性解读；传统的"验收示例"若同时被两种解读满足则毫无价值。因此需要一种能在生成前消歧、生成中约束、生成后可执行验证的机制。

Method: 在常规的"先写验收示例"流程中插入两步：(1) 按名称枚举需求中所有未明确指定的点（决策点）；(2) 对每个决策点构造两个仅在该点上不同的"用完即弃"实现，仅保留那些执行后两者结果不同的候选输入，即"分离输入"。该输入连同两种结果交由人选定其一，记录为"决策钉"（命名点 + 已确认输入 + 选定值）。同一记录随后用于约束代码生成以及通过执行判定是否符合需求。

Result: 在40个任务（配对参考实现）和两个模型的基准上：92.5%的决策点获得了分离输入，85-90%的钉记录了预期决策；在703个独立生成实现的核查中，钉与基准分类的一致性为96-97%，仅在三个任务上不一致，其中一处双方分类器均犯错。作为生成约束时，钉在210次生成中于钉定输入处全部被遵守；在留出输入上钉与同等范围的散文规则相比，38个单元中无一更差，但也未优于相同范围的散文规则。每一次散文规则下的合规失败源于模型自行决定规则的适用范围；其中一例甚至静默地颠覆了另一条已记录决策，通过两模型的留一法归因于单一规则，被文本级调和遗漏但被重跑记录的输入捕获。由于此类冲突样本过少，无法评估回归步骤，作者说明了原因。

Conclusion: "决策钉"机制能够将自然语言需求中隐式的未明确选择转化为显式、可验证的记录，作为消歧工具、生成约束和合规检查手段均有效，与散文规则在相同时不逊色且能捕获散文规则遗漏的、由范围误判引发的颠覆性冲突；但因其捕获的此类冲突样本极少，所提出的回归步骤无法在本基准上得到充分评估。

Abstract: A natural-language requirement leaves questions open, and a model asked to implement it settles them silently: across 600 generated test suites from three models, 42.7% contain no test that distinguishes the competing readings. An acceptance example written before implementing is the usual remedy, but an example both readings satisfy resolves nothing. We insert two steps into that practice: enumerate the requirement's underspecified points by name, then for each construct two throwaway implementations differing only in that point and keep a candidate input only if executing both shows they disagree. The result is recorded as a decision pin: the named point, the confirmed input, and the value the person chose between the two exhibited results. The same record then constrains generation and decides compliance by execution. On a benchmark of 40 tasks with paired reference implementations and two models, a separating input is obtained for 92.5% of decision points and a pin identifying the intended decision for 85-90%. As checks on 703 independently generated implementations, pins agree with the benchmark's classification on 96-97%, with disagreements on three tasks, one where both classifiers erred. As generation constraints, pins are honoured at the pinned input in all 210 generations and are never worse than a prose rule on held-out inputs in 38 cells, though no better than prose stating the same scope. Every compliance failure under a prose rule came from the model deciding the rule's scope itself; one such case silently overturned another recorded decision, was attributed to a single rule by leave-one-out on both models, and was missed by text-level reconciliation but caught by re-running the recorded input. The setting yields too few such conflicts to evaluate a regression step, and we say why.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [227] [Counterfactual Predictions in Scientific Emulators Without Controlled Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02252)
*Dingling Yao,Kahaan Gandhi,Valentin Duruisseaux,Boris Bonev,Francesco Locatello,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReRoute是一个轻量级科学反事实预测框架，将观测数据与部分机理知识相结合，无需受控干预数据。它通过固定预训练模型中目标输入到参考值，并通过已知机理通路重新引入变化，使下游响应由数据驱动学习。在对流扩散和气候模拟中均显著提升了反事实预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学模拟器在观测数据上表现良好，但在"假设性"反事实查询（如固定CO₂的情景）上常因输入变量共变而失效。传统解决方案需要生成受控模拟数据，但成本高昂且在许多实际场景中不可得。本文旨在利用部分机理知识替代受控实验数据。

Method: ReRoute框架：(1)将预训练骨干模型的目标输入s固定为参考值s₀；(2)通过已知机理通路Γ(s₀,s)重新引入s的变化；(3)在原始观测数据上微调。文章还提供了基于因果SCM的可识别性定理，并在Lean 4中机器验证。

Result: 对流扩散系统：反事实响应误差降低高达89.6%（在10倍于微调时长的滚动预测中）。气候模拟（ACE2）：在CO₂严重分布偏移下聚合误差降低18.2–31.8%，同时保持标准条件下的性能。ERA5再分析：固定CO₂时显著保留地表升温，热带气旋气候学更接近ERA5。计算成本仅为重新训练受控模拟模型的一小部分。

Conclusion: ReRoute通过结合观测数据与部分机理知识，提供了一种实用的科学反事实预测途径。其核心贡献在于因果识别保证与机制引导适应的结合，适用于气候、化学、生物学等多个科学领域，无需昂贵的受控实验即可实现稳健的分布外预测。

Abstract: Many scientific questions require reasoning about what was never observed: What if the conditions, interventions, or history had been different? Models can predict accurately on observed data yet fail on such what-if queries when correlated inputs are varied independently. A common remedy is to add controlled simulation data in which these factors are explicitly disentangled, but this requires access to a simulator, can be computationally expensive, and inherits the simulator's modeling assumptions. We introduce ReRoute, a framework for targeted scientific what-if prediction that combines factual data with partial mechanistic knowledge, without requiring controlled intervention data for adaptation. ReRoute fixes the queried input of a pretrained backbone to a reference value, reintroduces its variation through a known mechanistic pathway, and fine-tunes on the original factual data, while leaving downstream effects to the learned dynamics. We provide a causal identification result for this construction under explicit structural assumptions, with the core argument machine-checked in Lean. After showing that ReRoute achieves highly accurate counterfactual predictions in a controlled advection-diffusion system where exact responses are available, we turn to state-of-the-art climate emulation. On held-out coupled-climate interventions, ReRoute reduces aggregate climate error by 18.2-31.8% under severe CO$_2$ distribution shifts while preserving skill under standard conditions, at a small fraction of the cost of retraining on additional controlled simulations, without even accounting for the substantial expense of generating such data. Finally, on an emulator trained from historical ERA5 reanalysis, where no counterfactual reference exists, ReRoute preserves substantially more of the surface warming implied by the observed boundary conditions under a fixed-CO$_2$ counterfactual.

</details>


### [228] [Overcoming Challenges of Interpretive Structural Modeling with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02254)
*Everett Rush,David J. Icove,Ari Kim,Byung H. Park,Michael A. Langston*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种集成LLM的ISM（解释性结构建模）方法，通过将大语言模型作为"不完美专家"来自动发现因果图，以替代传统ISM中依赖领域专家（SME）进行两两比较的繁琐流程。研究比较了pairwise、k-wise、rowwise和full graph四种提示策略在三个LLM模型上的表现，并引入了检索增强生成（RAG）扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ISM过程需要领域专家对所有因子对进行反复的两两比较标注，这一过程劳动密集、易出错且难以扩展（通常仅限5-32个因子）。随着LLM在因果图发现任务中展现出的能力，作者希望利用LLM替代或辅助SME，实现ISM流程的自动化与规模化。

Method: 方法包含三个核心要点：(1) 采用允许环路的更通用因果图定义；(2) 直接发现SSIM的传递闭包SSIM*而非原始SSIM（基于Proposition 2的理论证明，即完美专家在任何辅助变量子集下都能发现传递闭包）；(3) 可选地集成RAG，使用Docling转换文档并通过嵌入检索相关文本块作为上下文。算法1以迭代方式构造图，每个查询涉及k个变量；算法2扩展支持RAG。实验测试了GPT-5.2、GPT-OSS 120B和Nemotron Super 3三个模型，使用9个已发表的ISM研究作为基准数据集（节点数7-17，边数17-115）。

Result: 主要结果：(1) GPT-5.2整体表现最佳（F1分数和SHD均最优）；(2) GPT-5.2使用rowwise方法+RAG取得最高F1分数0.77（SHD=160）；(3) GPT-OSS-120B使用full graph方法+RAG取得最低SHD=135（F1=0.73）；(4) 所有模型均呈现"单次提示中比较数量越多，性能越好"的趋势；(5) RAG在rowwise和full graph方法中带来性能提升。

Conclusion: 该研究证明LLM适合作为SSIM发现的辅助工具，ISM是LLM的一个良好应用场景。rowwise和full graph是最佳提示策略。未来工作包括将此方法应用于PTSD护理中的障碍与促进因素建模（可扩展到比传统ISM更多的变量），以及探索ISM图在智能体工作流中的上下文学习和LLM训练阶段的集成应用。代码已在GitHub开源。

Abstract: Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) is a well-known process for multi-criteria decision making. The success of ISM over other methodologies is its ability to model causal relationships, the binary scale of factors, and resulting hierarchical representation. Traditionally, the modeling process is performed by repeated interactions with subject matter experts until consensus is reached. This process is tedious, labor-intense, and most importantly limits the ability of ISM to scale to studies with hundreds of variables. Drawing on existing work of causal graph discovery with large language models (LLM) as imperfect experts, this work explores an integrated LLM-ISM approach for ISM. Pairwise, k-wise, rowwise, and full graph discovery methodologies are compared and evaluated. It is shown that causal graph discovery methods for ISM perform best using rowwise (SHD=160, F1-score=0.77) and full graph methods (SHD=135, F1-score=0.73).

</details>


### [229] [Diffusion-Based Synthetic Data Pretraining for Enhancing Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02292)
*E. Riveros,D. Vega-Oliveros,A. Soriano-Vargas,A. Rocha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于扩散模型的合成数据预训练策略，用于增强智能手表进食/饮水等细微饮食活动的识别。该方法将PaD-TS扩散模型中的注意力机制替换为双向GRU以适配短序列惯性数据，生成少数类合成样本对CABiGRU进行两阶段预训练-微调，在DEO数据集上将平衡准确率从基线的86.55%提升至90.55%，优于PCF-GAN对抗式预训练基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 饮食活动（吃、喝）的识别对健康监测和慢性病管理具有重要价值，但这些活动具有手腕运动细微、时序模式短促的特点，且在真实数据集中属于少数类，传统HAR模型因类别不平衡和特征细微而泛化能力不足。现有数据增强方法（SMOTE、自编码器、GAN）难以保持时间序列的时序连续性和多变量依赖关系，因此需要一种能更好地建模多元时序结构的生成方法来解决少数类欠拟合问题。

Method: （1）数据预处理：将加速度计、陀螺仪、磁力计信号分割为5秒窗口（50%重叠），每窗口500个时间步×9个特征；（2）扩散模型：基于PaD-TS框架，将其注意力编码-解码器替换为双向GRU块，以更好地捕获短惯性序列的时序依赖，仅为少数类（吃、喝）生成合成样本；（3）两阶段训练：第一阶段仅用合成数据对CABiGRU的卷积和GRU层进行自监督预训练，第二阶段在真实DEO数据上以低学习率（1e-4）进行微调并引入分类头；（4）系统性地探索了4种分类头配置（light/balanced/deep/classic）与4种激活函数（GELU/SiLU/Tanh/ReLU）的组合。

Result: 在DEO数据集（drinking/eating/other三类，90名受试者主体划分协议）上，最佳配置GELU+deep分类头达到90.55%平衡准确率，相比无增强基线（86.55%）提升约4个百分点，相比PCF-GAN对抗式预训练（88.02%）提升2.5个百分点。少数类敏感度显著提升（Drink从82.69%升至88.49%，Eat从87.01%升至90.14%），宏F1从0.7573提升至0.8243，mAP从0.6427提升至0.7272。学习曲线显示预训练减少了过拟合，验证损失更稳定。混淆矩阵显示误分类主要集中在Drink与Eat之间，但扩散方法生成的合成数据保留跨传感器依赖和时序一致性优于GAN。但合成数据量翻倍（从N到2N）反而导致平衡准确率下降至83.38%，说明预训练收益并非随数据量单调递增。

Conclusion: 扩散模型合成预训练策略能有效增强细微饮食活动的识别能力，通过为少数类生成保留时序连续性和多传感器依赖关系的合成样本，可显著提升分类器对不平衡数据的泛化能力。然而合成数据量需要谨慎控制，过多反而会引入冗余模式降低迁移效果。该方法与具体识别骨干网络解耦，可推广至其他序列模型和多元惯性HAR任务。未来工作将扩展到老年人及特定健康状况数据集，增加传感器模态并引入可解释性方法。

Abstract: Human activity recognition (HAR) is increasingly important for healthcare, well-being, and daily monitoring ap- plications, for which detecting alimentary activities such as eating and drinking can provide actionable insight into dietary habits and chronic disease management. HAR systems, however, often underperform on subtle and underrepresented classes, limiting their utility in real-world dietary monitoring. This work builds upon CABiGRU, a convolutional architecture with Bidirectional GRU layers, multi-head attention, and residual connections, designed to capture discriminative temporal patterns from smart- watch accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer data. To improve CaBiGRU's generalization and reduce underfitting in the minority class, we leverage synthetic sensor data windows using a diffusion model and adopt a two-stage training strategy: pre-training CABiGRU on synthetic data, followed by fine-tuning on the real-world data. On the DEO (drinking/eating/other) dataset, the proposed pipeline achieves a balanced accuracy of 90.6%, improving over a strong supervised baseline and showing the benefits of diffusion-based synthetic pre-training for recognizing alimentary activities and representing a step forward dealing with unbalanced classes. These results suggest that combining diffusion-generated data with targeted fine-tuning enhances robust recognition of dietary behaviors, supporting more reliable deployment in healthcare and nutrition-monitoring settings.

</details>


### [230] [$Ψ$-Resilience: Model-Free Feature Importance from 1D Topological Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02299)
*Fabian Galis,Darian Onchis,Pedro Real Jurado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Ψ-Resilience 是一种基于一维拓扑信号（零维持续同调）的模型无关特征重要性方法。它对每个类别估计类条件密度，取其在特征轴上的逐点绝对差构造"类别不一致景观"，再通过持续同源分析聚合在用户设定扰动尺度 Δ 下存活的拓扑特征，得到可审计、稳健的特征重要性分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特征重要性方法多为模型相关（如 SHAP），其结果依赖于具体的拟合模型、超参数与随机初始化，不同模型可能在同一数据上给出截然不同的重要性排序；而真正"数据内在"的特征重要性应是数据生成分布的函数，与具体模型无关。此外，基于数据的方法往往只给出标量分数，无法揭示类别分离在特征轴上的局部结构。

Method: 对每个特征 j，用 Scott 法则的 KDE 估计各类条件密度；当 K=2 时取两类密度差的绝对值作为"不一致信号" f_j(t)，K>2 时对每对类别分别计算；在一维网格上构造立方复形，对 -f 建立上层星形滤过，计算零维持续同调得到 (b_l, d_l) 区间，定义每条柱的基础韧性 r_l = (d_l - b_l)/2；在用户设定的稳健尺度 Δ_abs 下，r_l^(Δ) = max{r_l - Δ_abs, 0}，最后用 max/sum/mean 算子聚合得到 Ψ_Δ(j)。

Result: 在合成数据上（K=3,4,5,6，含 Toeplitz、随机 SPD 协方差、不同 SNR 及非线性变换），Ψ-Resilience 与真值的 Spearman 秩相关系数达 0.748–0.818，与 SHAP、置换重要性、偏依赖影响处于同一性能区间，显著优于互信息和 drop-column。在 7 个真实数据集上，与 SHAP 的秩相关在 0.645–0.964 之间（Diabetes 130-US 为 0.964，Covertype 为 0.904）。运行时间方面，在六类合成默认设置下仅 0.502 秒，显著快于 SHAP、置换重要性和 drop-column。

Conclusion: Ψ-Resilience 提供了一种纯粹数据驱动、可审计、可调稳健尺度的全局特征重要性方法，在精度上可与基于模型的方法显著领先，于计算成本极低，定位为模型无关、分布层面的"拓扑审计"工具，可与 SHAP 等方法互补使用。局限性在于：(1) 本质上是单变量的，无法捕捉纯交互驱动的特征重要性；(2) KDE 带宽选择、样本量与类别不平衡对结果敏感，仍需系统的带宽选择与不确定性量化；(3) 当前仅针对分类任务，回归与结构化输出需进一步推广。

Abstract: We introduce $\Psi$-Resilience, a model-free feature importance method that derives explanations directly from the data itself via 1D topological signals. Our method constructs a class-disagreement landscape by estimating class-conditional densities and taking their pointwise absolute difference along the feature axis. Then, the 0-dimensional persistence of this 1D signal defines a resilience functional that aggregates only those topological features that survive perturbations up to a robustness scale which is set by the user. This gives us a context-robust importance score that is inherently auditable via the underlying 1D landscapes and their persistence. We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real datasets. On synthetic generators with specified ground-truth importance, $\Psi$-Resilience recovers the ranking of features with high fidelity, achieving Spearman rank correlations up to 0.8 and performing competitively with multiple feature importance methods, including SHAP and mutual information. On real datasets with no known ground truth, our technique agrees with these methods, with correlations up to 0.9. These results show that $\Psi$-Resilience is a stable explanation method that enables rigorous, distribution-level auditing of feature importance without relying on a predictive model.

</details>


### [231] [Slow-Fast Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02324)
*Xiaofei Yin,Tong Chu,Jiyuan Fu,Jun Lan,Shuheng Zhou,Huijia Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）导致学生模型偏离初始化、引发能力干扰（capability interference）的问题，提出SF-MOPD框架。该方法通过维护快速模型（当前学生）与慢速模型（学生参数的EMA）作为动态能力参考，在log-probability空间中计算每个教师诱导的更新方向，仅移除与慢速约束方向相反的分量。在多个模型规模上验证了其在保持通用能力的同时有效吸收领域专家能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将多个领域专家的能力整合到单一学生模型中，但训练过程中学生模型逐渐偏离其初始化，导致通用能力下降（即"能力干扰"现象）。现有的解决方案（如KL正则化约束学生朝向初始化）使用固定锚点，无法区分领域知识获取与通用能力退化，在抑制干扰的同时也压制了领域专长的学习。

Method: SF-MOPD框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 慢速能力参考（Slow-Fast Capability Reference）：维护快速模型（当前学生，直接被教师更新）和慢速模型（学生参数的EMA，从相同初始化开始），慢速模型作为动态能力参考，融合通用基础与已确认的领域专长；(2) 慢速-快速投影（Slow-Fast Projection）：在log-probability空间中定义教师诱导的更新方向η_t^(k)和慢速约束方向η_s，通过计算点积判断对齐性，仅移除η_t^(k)中与η_s相反（负相关）的分量，保留对齐和正交分量以编码互补知识；(3) 总体目标函数：L_SF-MOPD = L_sf + β·L_MOPD，其中L_sf使用投影后的更新方向计算JSD损失，L_MOPD作为正则化项保持原始优化景观。所有操作在log-prob空间完成，无需教师特定的梯度存储或额外可训练参数，开销极小。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL-2B/4B/8B三种模型规模上，基于11个基准测试（5个通用+6个领域专用）进行实验：(1) 2B规模：领域专用平均从38.4%提升至44.1%，通用能力维持66.4%；(2) 4B规模：领域专用平均从54.2%提升至56.9%，整体平均64.8%为最佳；(3) 8B规模：领域专用60.4%（超过MOPD 1.4%），通用76.4%（超过MOPD 3.1%），整体67.7%优于所有对比方法（包括MOPD Ref、Open-MOPD、VAD-MOPD、MeanTeacher、OPD-V等）。消融实验表明：移除Slow-Fast Projection导致性能下降3.7%（最大单组件增益），移除L_MOPD正则化或CenterNorm分别下降0.4%和0.9%。对β的敏感性分析显示β=0.1时效果最佳（67.7%）。在最小任务异质性冲突设置下，SF-MOPD仍能有效保持通用能力。

Conclusion: SF-MOPD通过慢速-快速模型设计有效解决了MLLM多教师蒸馏中的能力干扰问题。其核心优势在于使用动态EMA参考替代固定初始化锚点，以及通过方向投影机制精确移除有害更新分量而保留有益学习信号。该方法在多个模型规模上一致优于vanilla MOPD及其他先进方法，在领域专长吸收与通用能力保持之间实现了更好的平衡，且引入极小的计算开销，为MLLM的能力整合提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Foundation multimodal large language models are designed to support a broad spectrum of capabilities across diverse domains. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) provides an effective framework for consolidating domain-specific expertise into a single student model. However, MOPD training gradually drives the student away from its initialization model, and general capabilities decline as the displacement grows, resulting in capability interference. A direct remedy is constraining the student toward its initialization, but this suppresses the acquisition of domain expertise as well. We propose Slow-Fast Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (SF-MOPD), which couples a fast model, the current student updated directly by each teacher, with a slow model, an exponential moving average of the student. The slow model absorbs the learning signal gradually, serving as a moving capability reference that fuses the general foundation with confirmed domain expertise. For each teacher, SF-MOPD computes the teacher-induced update in log-probability space and removes only the component that pushes the fast model further away from the slow model, while retaining aligned and orthogonal components. Experiments across multiple model scales demonstrate that SF-MOPD effectively mitigates capability interference, enhances specialized multimodal capabilities, and reduces the average degradation on general-capability benchmarks, consistently outperforming vanilla MOPD.

</details>


### [232] [Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02359)
*Doseok Jang,Jon Ander Campos,Youran Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LMOPD（Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation），一种在显式优先级下集成多个奖励专精教师的多教师蒸馏方法，通过字典序路由和优先级感知的函数空间投影来保护高优先级能力不被低优先级目标所损害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR通常仅优化答案正确性，但实用语言模型行为还需要高质量推理和简洁响应。现有多奖励后训练方法（标量化奖励、Rewarded Soups、MOPD等）要么将目标视为可补偿的，要么不能显式保护奖励优先级顺序。当权衡不对称时（如简洁性不应以正确性为代价），现有方法会失败。

Method: LMOPD包含两个核心组件：(1) 字典序路由（Lexicographic Rollout Routing）：对每个学生rollout按优先级顺序检查各目标的门控（离散目标用绝对阈值，连续目标用group-relative advantage），选择首个未达标目标对应的专家教师；全部通过则自蒸馏。(2) 优先级感知函数空间投影（Priority-Aware Function-Space Projection）：将所选专家的centered log-policy correction与高优先级专家的correction计算内积，仅当为负时移除与之冲突的分量。该投影在函数空间执行，通过流式Gram矩阵实现，无需额外的student backward pass。方法在30B-A3B MoE模型上评估，覆盖二专家和三奖励、四专家和五奖励两种设置。

Result: 在二专家设置下，LMOPD完全保留了准确性和推理质量增益（~103%），同时获得46.9%的简洁性增益，平均保留增益84.4%为统一方法最高。在四专家设置下，LMOPD保留~90%的准确性增益和~89%的推理正确性增益，而次优基线仅约57%。消融实验表明：字典序路由优于随机路由（高出23-29点平均保留增益），投影机制在四专家设置中实质性参与，将顶端优先级的保留增益从54%/70%提升至91%/89%。三种子复现显示种子间标准差较小。

Conclusion: LMOPD通过显式优先级排序和投影机制，有效保护了多目标集成中的高优先级能力，证明了rollout条件蒸馏作为整合专精模型、避免将优先化能力坍缩为单一全局权衡的实用路径。方法被定位为局部启发式而非全局最优控制，并存在路由饥饿等局限性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually optimizes answer correctness, yet useful language-model behavior also requires high-quality reasoning and concise responses. Existing multi-reward post-training methods typically scalarize rewards or combine specialists without explicitly protecting a reward priority order. This is problematic when trade-offs are asymmetric: conciseness, for example, should not improve at the cost of correctness. We introduce Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation (LMOPD), a multi-teacher method for integrating reward-specialized policies under explicit priorities. For each student rollout, LMOPD selects the specialist for the first objective whose gate detects a deficiency, then locally projects its centered log-policy correction to remove components that oppose higher-priority specialists. We evaluate 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts transformer models in two- and four-expert settings on three math benchmarks, measuring retained specialist gains. With two experts, LMOPD's point estimates fully retain the accuracy and reasoning-quality gains while acquiring $46.9\%$ of the conciseness gain. With four experts, it retains $\approx90\%$ of both the accuracy gain and reasoning-correctness gain, compared to only $\approx57\%$ by the next best evaluated baseline. Matched four-expertablations show that lexicographic routing outperforms random routing and that projection further strengthens both top-priority capabilities. Across both scales, LMOPD preserves the highest-priority capabilities more effectively than the existing baselines we evaluate, demonstrating the value of explicit priorities for specialist integration.

</details>


### [233] [The Surprising Effectiveness of Shared Memory in Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02383)
*Giovanni Monea,Keshav Ramji,Yousef El-Kurdi,Luis A. Lastras,Yoav Artzi,Nathan Godey,Ramón Fernandez Astudillo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出在循环Transformer（Looped Transformer）中引入"共享内存"机制：仅第一次循环写入完整的KV缓存，后续循环只读取该共享内存并保留一个短窗口的本地缓存。LPT及其混合变体h-LPT在150M-1B参数规模上均超越标准Transformer和常规循环Transformer：五层循环下，在FineWeb-Edu上将验证困惑度降低1.12-1.82，同时上下文内存减少76-79%。分析表明共享内存与本地内存学习到不同的表示（PCA聚类清晰可分），后续循环主要关注共享内存，并且共享内存充当从最终损失到第一次循环的"梯度高速公路"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的循环Transformer通过权重共享增加计算，但每次循环都写入独立的KV缓存，导致上下文内存随循环深度线性增长，削弱了用循环模型替代大模型的优势。现有的推理时缓存共享虽能省内存但有质量损失。作者由此提出问题：如果模型从训练开始就为共享而设计，会发生什么？

Method: 作者提出Memory Sharing机制：在LPT中，第一次循环（state recursion）写入完整KV缓存；后续循环（prediction recursions）通过单个softmax同时关注共享缓存和一个长度为ω的本地滑动窗口（默认ω=64）。在混合架构h-LPT中，对Gated DeltaNet的每五层全注意力层应用相同规则。模型在FineWeb-Edu上从零预训练150M-1B规模，使用最终损失（final loss）或自适应损失（adaptive loss）目标。分析手段包括：困惑度比较、注意力分布统计、PCA表征可视化、梯度范数贡献分析以及共享缓存梯度阻断消融实验。

Result: 在S/M/L三个规模上，LPT比匹配的LT基线困惑度降低0.38-1.09，精度提升0.4-4.8个百分点，KV内存减少2.0-4.7倍。五次循环下，LPT在1B模型上将困惑度降至10.32（std为11.35），仅多用6.25%的内存；h-LPT降至10.23，内存反而减少76-79%。分析发现：(1)共享与本地键的表示在PCA空间中形成明显分离的聚类；(2)后续循环将57-80%的注意力分配给共享内存；(3)共享内存提供直达第一次循环的梯度路径，使其梯度范数接近单层std参考；(4)阻断该梯度路径会导致困惑度上升甚至训练崩溃；(5)LPT使用final loss比adaptive loss更稳定，而LT需要adaptive loss才能在深层保持稳定。

Conclusion: 将内存共享视为架构归纳偏置而非仅推理技巧，能同时改善循环Transformer的质量与内存效率。循环的第一次迭代专门构建完整上下文记忆，后续迭代专注于预测，这种角色分工通过不同的键表示和共享内存的高注意力分配体现出来。共享读取同时充当梯度高速公路，对深层循环的稳定训练至关重要。h-LPT在质量与内存权衡曲线上为循环模型确立了新前沿，且实际GPU吞吐可优于标准Transformer。

Abstract: Looped Transformers apply the same layers several times per token, adding compute to improve quality without more parameters. Each recursion, however, writes its own key-value cache, so memory still grows with compute. Inference-time techniques can shrink this cache at a cost in quality. We pretrain looped language models to share memory: only the first recursion writes a cache, and later recursions read it while keeping a short window of their own. Surprisingly, we find that sharing memory does not cost quality and instead improves it. At 150M-1B parameters, our Looped Prediction Transformer (LPT) and its hybrid variant set a new quality-memory frontier for looped models: with five recursions, the hybrid lowers validation perplexity on FineWeb-Edu by 1.12-1.82 relative to a same-size standard Transformer while using 76-79% less context memory. Through an extensive analysis, we investigate why memory sharing helps. Shared and local memory develop different representations, and later recursions attend mostly to the shared memory, which also acts as a gradient highway to the first recursion.

</details>


### [234] [Inherit-MAS: Test-Time Evolution of Multi-Agent Systems through Workflow and Execution Inheritance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02396)
*Songtao Wei,Yi Li,Zhichun Guo,Bingzhe Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Inherit-MAS，将生物进化中"遗传与选择"的理念引入多智能体系统（MAS）的测试时进化，在工作流层面和执行层面显式实现继承机制。方法通过元模型合成工作流，由独立评判器诊断缺陷，并在每轮优化中仅保留有用的节点并施加一次经过验证的编辑以修复诊断出的问题；执行时通过请求完全匹配验证，仅在解析请求与执行上下文指纹均一致时才复用存储结果，从而避免冗余推理。在WorkBench和HotpotQA FullWiki两个基准上，Inherit-MAS使用GPT-4o-mini和Qwen3-32B作为工作智能体时均优于EvoAgent、EvoMAS和TacoMAS等进化型MAS基线，且执行继承可分别节省29.1%和34.6%的工作智能体推理token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统在处理复杂任务时面临两大挑战：(1) 有效的工作流难以预先设计，需要测试时基于执行反馈进行进化；(2) 现有的进化方法要么大范围修改工作流会破坏有用组件，要么保留配置/输出不验证其在新版本中是否仍然有效，导致冗余计算。该研究受生物进化中遗传与选择相互作用的启发，旨在探索如何在测试时利用执行反馈提升任务表现的同时控制推理成本。

Method: Inherit-MAS采用基于种群的测试时进化循环，核心机制包括：(1) **初始合成与判断**：元模型从任务和接口合成初始工作流G₀，独立评判器对执行结果评分（完成度、需求覆盖、事实依据、总体质量）并给出节点级反馈；(2) **工作流继承**：在优化轮次中，Select阶段丢弃被判定为无用的可移除节点，Edit阶段对保留的工作流施加一次经过接口验证的原子编辑（修改prompt、子任务、工具、增删节点/边等），其余部分原样保留；(3) **执行继承**：通过Touch和Desc定义保守的受影响区域D_k，只有当节点的完整解析请求（含上游记录和执行上下文指纹ϕ_k）的SHA-256哈希与存储记录匹配时，才复用存储结果，否则实时执行；写入操作始终实时执行以避免状态冲突；(4) **排名与返回**：在线排名键按硬执行错误、输出有效性、质量分、覆盖分、依据分和候选顺序排序，预算耗尽后返回最优候选。

Result: 在WorkBench（130个任务）和HotpotQA FullWiki（300个问题）两个基准上的实验表明：(1) 使用GPT-4o-mini工作智能体时，Inherit-MAS在WorkBench上达到55.4%完成率，在HotpotQA上达到49.7%联合F1，超过EvoAgent（33.8%/34.8%）、EvoMAS（30.8%/39.2%）和TacoMAS（34.6%/47.8%）；(2) 使用Qwen3-32B工作智能体时仍优于所有进化型MAS基线；(3) 执行继承使工作智能体token消耗降低29.1%（WorkBench）和34.6%（HotpotQA），总token降低5.3%和18.1%；(4) 在确定性Qwen3-14B+LiveCodeBench基质上验证了继承产生字节级一致的节点输出；(5) Inherit-MAS的推理成本显著低于EvoMAS和TacoMAS（16.8×和22.9×/13.7×和2.1×），但在WorkBench上token仍多于Single ReAct（10.35M vs 3.26M）。

Conclusion: Inherit-MAS通过显式的工作流继承（保留有用节点并施加验证后的定向编辑）和执行继承（基于完整请求匹配的存储结果复用），实现了测试时MAS进化中质量与推理成本的有效权衡。该方法在两个基准上以两种骨干模型均超越现有进化型MAS基线，同时显著降低了工作智能体的推理开销。但研究也指出：(1) 局部编辑与质量改进并不强相关，编辑器质量的提升需要更好的增益估计器；(2) 评判器识别最优候选的能力存在差距（如WorkBench在线排名55.4% vs神谕63.1%）；(3) 进化过程呈现非单调性，应理解为依赖式迭代搜索而非确定性爬山。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built from large language models coordinate specialized agents to tackle complex tasks, but effective workflows are difficult to design in advance. Test-time evolution refines workflows using execution feedback, yet broad revisions can disturb useful components, while re-executing unchanged requests can incur redundant computation. Inspired by the interplay of inheritance and selection in biological evolution, we introduce Inherit-MAS, which makes inheritance explicit at the workflow and execution levels. A meta-model first synthesizes a workflow of worker agents with declared roles, communication inputs, and tool permissions, and a separately prompted judge scores each executed candidate and diagnoses its deficiencies. In ordinary refinement rounds, \emph{workflow inheritance} starts from the latest completed candidate, may discard removable nodes judged unhelpful, and applies a validated edit to address the diagnosed deficiency. When the new candidate executes, \emph{execution inheritance} inherits eligible stored results only if the complete resolved request and execution context match, avoiding redundant model and tool calls. With GPT-4o-mini workers, Inherit-MAS achieves 55.4\% completion on WorkBench and 49.7\% joint F1 on HotpotQA FullWiki, outperforming EvoAgent, EvoMAS, and TacoMAS. With Qwen3-32B workers, it also exceeds these evolving-MAS baselines on both benchmarks. Compared with rerunning the same controller with execution inheritance disabled, execution inheritance reduces worker-token usage by 29.1\% on WorkBench and 34.6\% on HotpotQA, and total token usage by 5.3\% and 18.1\%.

</details>


### [235] [Efficient Neural Field Learning via Adaptive Coverage and Focused Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02410)
*Guang Zhao,Xihaier Luo,Huan-Hsin Tseng,Seungjun Lee,Shinjae Yoo,Yihui Ren,Wei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ACES框架，通过自适应空间分区与区域级重要性加权，将"覆盖性"与"重要性"解耦，以解决隐式神经表示(INR)训练中均匀子采样效率低下的问题，在高度局部化的复杂场中加速收敛并降低误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: INR在高维连续场建模中训练效率不足，且现有方法的点级自适应采样常造成采样过度集中于局部高误差区域，而忽略全局覆盖，导致信息冗余与优化效率受限。

Method: 1) 自适应空间分区（递归细化高方差区域，使区域内梯度更同质，降低梯度方差）；2) 区域级重要性加权（基于区域均残差构造有偏加权策略）。理论分析证明：分区通过提高区域内同质性降低梯度方差；受控的有偏加权可提升一步优化代理 S_w²。实现上采用双时间尺度设计：分区慢更新（每200步），权重快更新（每步）。

Result: 在Navier-Stokes涡量场（Re=10,000, NS2D）与BubbleML沸腾场（PoolBoiling2D/3D, NS3D）四类科学场重建任务中，ACES较均匀采样与点级自适应基线INT、EVOS收敛更快、误差更低；尤其在PoolBoiling2D这类高度局部化界面场中增益最大。联合时空实验中，5000 epoch下较均匀采样分别降低相对MSE 21.4%与3.3%。理论分析：自适应分区使方差降低乘子 m^(-ν)（局部变异函数模型）；有效策略（残差-对数秩相关为正）在60/60配置中均成立。运行时开销约为均匀采样的1.80倍。

Conclusion: 区域级结构化采样是高效神经场学习的有前景方向；ACES通过覆盖性+重要性解耦设计在复杂异质科学场中验证有效，但当前实现存在额外采样开销，理论分析聚焦局部一步行为而非长期非凸动力学。

Abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) provide a flexible framework for modeling high-dimensional continuous fields, but their training is often inefficient due to uniform subsampling that ignores spatial heterogeneity. Existing adaptive sampling methods partially address this issue by prioritizing high-error samples, but typically operate at the point level, often leading to redundant sampling in localized regions and insufficient coverage of the domain. We propose ACES (Adaptive Coverage-aware Efficient Sampling), a structured sampling framework that improves training efficiency by decoupling coverage and importance. ACES constructs adaptive spatial partitions to ensure domain coverage and reduce redundancy, and applies region-level importance weighting to prioritize informative regions during training. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that adaptive partitioning reduces gradient variance by increasing within-region homogeneity, and that controlled bias in region-level weighting may improve optimization efficiency relative to standard unbiased estimators. Experiments on scientific field learning tasks demonstrate that ACES achieves faster convergence and lower error than uniform and pointwise adaptive sampling baselines, with the largest gains in fields with highly localized complexity.

</details>


### [236] [Geometry-Aware Time Reparameterization for Flow-Map Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02427)
*Félix Dedek,Makoto Yamada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于法向加速度的几何感知时间重参数化方法，将流图蒸馏中的时间坐标重新映射以均衡"难度"分布，从而在一步和少步生成中提升样本质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配/FM 生成需要大量 ODE 积分评估，蒸馏方法可将多步压缩为少步。但不同时间区间对有限时间流图的拟合难度不同，作者假设法向加速度大的轨迹段更难蒸馏，因此希望通过改变教师的时间参数化（而非轨迹几何）来降低蒸馏难度。

Method: 1）定义硬度剖面 h_p(t) = (E[n_t(x_t)^p])^(1/p)，其中 n_t 为法向加速度大小，作为时间相关蒸馏困难的代理。2）推导定理：ψ(t) = ∫₀ᵗ√h_p(u)du / ∫₀¹√h_p(u)du，ϕ = ψ⁻¹，使重参数化后硬度恒为 (∫₀¹√h_p(u)du)²。3）从 M 条教师轨迹用有限差分估计材料加速度，投影到法向方向，剔除最大 5% 后聚合得 ĥ_p，使用 PCHIP 拟合 (τ_k, t_k) 得到 C¹ 时钟 ϕ，参数 (δ, ξ) 控制强度。4）将其代入拉格朗日流图蒸馏 (LMD)，学生以变换后的 (α, β)=(ψ(s), ψ(t)) 为条件，速度场为 b̃_τ(x)=ϕ'(τ)b_{ϕ(τ)}(x)。图像实验使用物理时间位移缩放 (ϕ(β)-ϕ(α))，以分离时间分配与速度缩放。时钟仅在蒸馏前离线估计一次，无需教师重训练或额外推理时网络评估。

Result: 合成数据：2D 棋盘分布上，ϕ 学生在 1/2/3/4 步评估中均改善 KL、MMD、W₂。图像生成：CIFAR-10（35M）和 CelebA64（124M）上，ϕ 在所有匹配推理预算下均改善 FID：400k 步时 CIFAR-10 单步 FID 从 8.57→6.99，CelebA64 单步 FID 从 6.19→4.64。时钟自适应节点改善教师自身在 25 步 Heun 积分下的采样 FID 从 8.8→3.5。单步改进尤为显著，因该情形下推理时无中间采样点可调，差异反映流图本身的学习。

Conclusion: 几何感知时间重参数化可显著提升流图蒸馏质量，尤其在一步生成中表现突出，凸显时间坐标本身在学习有限时间传输中的核心作用。理论连接法向加速度与蒸馏误差仍是开放方向。该方法无需修改学生架构或增加推理成本，易于集成到现有 LMD 框架。

Abstract: Flow-map distillation enables one- and few-step generation by learning finite-time transitions of a pretrained generative ODE. We investigate whether changing the teacher's time parameterization can make these transitions easier to learn. Motivated by the hypothesis that trajectory segments with large normal acceleration are harder to distill, we propose a geometry-aware time reparameterization that allocates more student time to these regions while preserving the teacher's geometric paths and terminal distribution. We derive a shared clock that equalizes a population normal-acceleration statistic under suitable assumptions, and construct a practical approximation from robust, regularized estimates across teacher trajectories. We incorporate this clock into Lagrangian flow-map distillation, using the transformed time coordinate to condition the student. The clock is estimated once before distillation and requires neither teacher retraining nor additional student parameters or inference-time network evaluations. Experiments on synthetic data, CIFAR-10, and CelebA-64 show improved sample quality over identity-time distillation at matched inference budgets, including improvements in one- and two-step image generation. The gains in one-step generation, where no intermediate sampling times can be adjusted, highlight the benefits of time reparameterization during distillation.

</details>


### [237] [Are you Synthesizing or Recalling? Evaluating LLMs on Algorithmic Code Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02438)
*Nickil Maveli,Antonio Vergari,Shay B. Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了"参数化代码检索"(parametric code retrieval)概念,将LLM代码生成中"从参数记忆中复现已知算法"与"从零合成新解"这两种能力区分开来。构建了AlgoREval基准(599题/77算法/7语言/4图输入表示),评估15个模型,发现检索准确性主要受语言和输入表示等表面形式影响,而非模型大小或代码专精程度;提示增强仅在参数知识薄弱时有效;GRPO与SFT以互补方式缩小差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码生成基准将"检索"(从参数记忆中复现已知算法)与"合成"(从零推导新解)混为一谈,无法诊断出特定的失败模式。对于广泛存在于预训练语料中的经典算法,模型理应能够检索而非合成,但现有评估无法验证这一能力。现实中66%开发者遇到"几乎正确但差一点的代码",这正是检索失败的典型表现。

Method: 1) 构建AlgoREval基准:599个问题覆盖77个经典算法、14个领域、7种编程语言(Python/C++/Java/C/JavaScript/Rust/Go),图算法附加4种输入表示(边表/邻接表/邻接矩阵/关联矩阵);2) 在零样本设置下评估15个7B-34B参数模型;3) 通过提示增强(+Hint语言无关伪代码;+Snippet语言相关参考代码)进行推理时干预;5) 通过SFT(监督微调)与GRPO(带执行奖励的分组相对策略优化)进行权重级适配;6) 通过复杂度斜率分析和名称/规范消融实验进一步区分检索与合成。

Result: 1) 零样本平均通过率41.2%,最高gpt-oss-20B达88.0%;检索准确率主要由语言和输入表示决定,与模型大小或代码专精程度相关性弱;Python/JS的主要失败模式为"错误输出"(可运行但静默返回错误结果);2) 提示增强整体上不能可靠改善(Δ=-0.6pp/-0.4pp),但在零样本通过率低于25%的困难子集上,snippet提升+3.9pp,hint提升+2.9pp;3) SFT整体提升+3.9pp(更广泛的语言覆盖),GRPO提升+2.0pp但在特定语言上获得更大单语言增益(JavaScript +14.3pp);AlgoSim相似性分析显示80%的配对共享相同算法结构但无逐字匹配,符合参数检索特征。

Conclusion: 参数化代码检索是可独立测量的能力,与合成能力具有不同的失败模式和可靠性含义。最具运行风险的失败是"错误输出"错误——可运行但静默返回错误结果。检索失败可通过互补方式部分修复:提示增强仅在参数知识确实缺失时有效;基于执行的微调在权重层面起作用,SFT实现更广泛的语言一致性收益,而GRPO的执行奖励将信号集中在特定语言上。实际部署AI生成的算法代码应进行系统验证。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in code generation, where success depends on both recalling relevant algorithmic knowledge and reasoning about how to apply it. However, existing LLM pipelines are opaque, with no explicit separation between these two components. We argue that for well-known algorithms whose canonical implementations are widely accessible in pretraining corpora, code generation is better measured as \textit{parametric code retrieval}: reproducing a named algorithm from internalised knowledge rather than synthesizing a novel one. We introduce AlgoREval, a benchmark of 599 problems spanning classical 77 algorithms across 14 domains, 7 programming languages, and 4 graph-input representations to evaluate this capability in isolation, and assess 15 models (7B--34B parameters) in a zero-shot setting. We find substantial variation in retrieval accuracy across languages and input representations, even for widely documented algorithms and show that prompt augmentation with retrieved code snippets or structured algorithmic hints improve accuracy on complex algorithms, while SFT achieves broader language gains and GRPO achieves larger per-language gains on specific languages. Together, our results establish parametric code retrieval as a distinct, measurable capability and caution against deploying AI-generated algorithmic code without systematic validation.\footnote{Code and dataset are available at this https URL

</details>


### [238] [Multi-Fidelity Policy Gradients Stabilize Data-Scarce Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02505)
*Xinjie Liu,Ruihan Zhao,Anirban Chaudhuri,Cyrus Neary,Ufuk Topcu,David Fridovich-Keil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MFPG-PPO，将多保真度策略梯度（MFPG）控制变量方法扩展到现代Actor-Critic框架（PPO），通过保持跨保真度相关性、监控估计不确定性以及预算感知的采样分配，解决了数据稀缺场景下on-policy强化学习不稳定的问题，在仿真和真实机器人上实现了稳定学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数据稀缺的on-policy强化学习场景中（如物理机器人每次更新仅能收集少量轨迹），策略梯度估计因高方差而变得不稳定。虽然低保真度（LF）模拟器数据廉价且丰富，但直接用于优化会引入偏差。现有方法要么直接优化有偏的LF目标，要么局限于REINFORCE算法，无法应用于现代GPU并行PPO训练。

Method: 提出MFPG-PPO算法，包含四大组件：(1) 多保真度数据采集——收集HF、耦合LF和非耦合LF三组轨迹，通过共享动作噪声和周期性重同步保持跨保真度相关性；(2) 构建配对统计量——为三种数据各设独立critic，匹配GAE步长以保持相关性的代价是引入少量偏差；(3) 系数拟合——每minibatch重拟合控制变量系数c并用EMA平滑；(4) 监控机制——通过统计显著性（bootstrap或Fisher-z检验）和经验方差缩减检查，防止估计器因系数误估而放大方差。此外提出预算感知版本（MFPG-PPO-BA），基于多保真度蒙特卡洛框架（Peherstorfer等）在线分配HF/LF采样预算。

Result: 在Isaac Lab的Unitree H1和ANYmal-D仿真运动任务中（HF环境数量从8到512，远少于默认4096），MFPG-PPO在14/16的设置中优于纯HF PPO，且从不显著更差；在最难任务H1 Rough的最HF预算下，其性能匹配使用16×更多HF数据的PPO。与DARC、PAR、Co-training、SAC等基线相比，MFPG-PPO是唯一在几乎所有设置下都改善且单调随HF数据扩展的方法。在物理Franka机械臂cube-picking任务中，仅用每次更新4个真实回合且无人类演示，MFPG-PPO将成功率从40%提升至91.7%，远超PPO HF-Only的55%。消融实验表明，朴素地将PPO替换REINFORCE会导致方差放大超过1000倍，而监控机制对此至关重要。

Conclusion: MFPG-PPO通过控制变量机制利用LF数据降低HF策略梯度估计的方差而不引入偏差，实现了数据稀缺下的稳定on-policy RL。该方法在仿真和真实机器人上均展现出可靠性（优于或等于HF-only基线）和可扩展性（随HF数据单调改善）。未来方向包括：通过表征对齐提升跨保真度相关性、降低重同步偏差、以及利用real-to-sim工具构建耦合LF模拟器。

Abstract: Policy gradient methods for on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) can become unstable when expensive, scarce target-domain data yield noisy gradient estimates. We address this challenge by complementing limited high-fidelity (HF) target-domain data with abundant, cheap, but biased low-fidelity (LF) data, e.g., from a simplified simulator. Most existing methods directly optimize biased objectives based on LF data. In contrast, the recently introduced multi-fidelity policy gradient (MFPG) framework uses LF data solely to construct a control variate that reduces variance and improves HF data efficiency without biasing the policy gradient estimator. However, published work on MFPG is limited to REINFORCE on small-scale simulation tasks. We develop MFPG for modern actor-critic learning in GPU-parallel simulation and on a physical robot. Our analysis and experiments show that naive extensions to proximal policy optimization (PPO) can lose cross-fidelity correlation or inflate variance. Our MFPG-PPO addresses these failures by redesigning the sampling, advantage estimation, and control variate construction to preserve cross-fidelity correlation, and by monitoring estimator uncertainty to prevent variance inflation. We also introduce a budget-aware MFPG-PPO to divide a fixed sampling budget among high- and low-fidelity data sources. Across simulated robot locomotion tasks of varying LF-to-HF transfer difficulty and HF data budgets, MFPG-PPO improves upon PPO trained on HF data alone in nearly all settings, and consistently matches the performance of PPO trained with 16x more HF data on the hardest task at the smallest HF budgets. In contrast, most baselines that use LF data perform well only where direct LF-to-HF transfer succeeds. MFPG-PPO enables stable learning on a physical Franka arm using only 4 real-robot episodes per update and no human demonstrations.

</details>


### [239] [Student-Guided Teacher Distillation for Efficient LLM Task Routing: Positioning Against Jev-Style System-1 Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02516)
*Haifeng Wu,Srinivasan Manoharan,Jian Wan,Fangbo Tu,Junhua Zhao,Xin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种学生引导的教师蒸馏流水线，用于在固定 60 类 LLM 任务分类体系下高效执行零样本 NLI 教师标注：紧凑的 ModernBERT 学生模型在单次前向传播中预测完整 60 类分布并选取 top-k 候选，较大的 DeBERTa-v3 零样本 NLI 教师仅对这些候选进行重排序，由此得到的教师标签迭代地改进学生模型。最佳学生检查点在 200 例评估集上达到 77.5% 的教师一致率，部署中的 v4 检查点达到 76.5%，Coverage@16 达 91–100%。论文还指出将截断的 top-k 教师分数当作完整 60 类软标签用于 KL 蒸馏会破坏"暗知识"并引入系统性偏差。完整评估（含嵌入检索基线、多 k 值覆盖率、人工审核测试集）仍在进行中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本 NLI 分类器用于将用户请求路由到专门 LLM 任务时，需对每个候选标签评估一对前提-假设对，成本随分类体系大小线性增长。在 60 类、固定语义任务分类的路由场景下，全标签集标注成为数据集构建的主要开销。已有工作（XMC 级联、Jev 等 System-1 编码器分类器、LLM 间路由）要么依赖嵌入检索/聚类派生短名单，要么训练方法未公开或基于强化学习，要么路由的是候选模型而非固定语义任务分类，缺乏一种针对固定分类体系、以端到端分类器自身作为候选生成器、可迭代收紧候选集的教师标注减成本方案。

Method: 流水线包含：教师为 deberta-v3-large-zeroshot-v2.0，对每个 (请求, 标签) 对进行零样本 NLI 评分；学生为带 60 类新初始化分类头的 ModernBERT-base，单次前向产生完整分布。迭代过程为：(1) 当前学生对未标注样本预测 top-k 候选；(2) 教师仅对 top-k 候选重排序；(3) 置信度阈值过滤后混合种子数据微调下一轮学生；(4) 测量覆盖率后可逐步缩小 k。训练损失为 α·CE(z_S, y_gold) + γ·CE(z_S, y_teacher) + β·T²·KL(softmax(z_S/T), p_teacher^(T))，其中 KL 仅在教师对全 60 类完整评分时使用，截断的 top-k 教师分数仅用于推导硬伪标签 y_teacher。部署采用 Nginx least_conn 负载均衡到 4 个 vLLM pooling 实例（每 GPU 一卡），单卡 GPU 内存利用率 0.20。

Result: 在 200 例评估集上：基线早期版本教师一致率较低；v2（公共 SWE 教师软标签）为 62.82%；v3（公共 SWE + 1000 合成分类样本）为 69.5%（139/200）；v4（教师聚焦蒸馏，从 ModernBERT-base 初始化）为 76.5%（153/200，已部署）；v5-full60（2218 个全 60 类教师评分样本，从 v4 初始化）为 71.5%（143/200，未超 v4）；v5-tuned（同 v5-full60 数据，1 epoch，lr 5e-6）为 77.5%（155/200，当前最佳）。覆盖率方面：在 300 例种子集（样本内）上 Coverage@4/8/16 = 74.3%/84.3%/91.3%，学生-教师 top-1 一致率仅 39.0%，学生 top-1 vs 人工金标准仅 19.0%；在 40 例 SWE-rebench 新鲜样本上 Coverage@4/8/16 = 80.0%/92.5%/100%，学生-教师一致率 62.5%。延迟方面：单次 WAN 调用均值 ~158–160 ms，p99 ~169–172 ms；WAN 批量 32 并发 32 时吞吐达 242.6 请求/s（7763.2 分类/s），p50 111.5 ms；服务器本地 wrk 测试 4 线程 64 连接下达约 5200–5250 请求/s，平均延迟 12.15–12.29 ms，单实例约 1290–1427 请求/s。观察到关键现象：截断 top-k 分数作为完整 KL 目标会引入系统性偏差（破坏"暗知识"）；增加合成数据并未自动提升一致率（v5-full60 反而低于 v4）；评估分布与训练分布的偏移显著影响一致率读数。

Conclusion: 论文提出并初步验证了学生引导的教师蒸馏流水线在固定 60 类 LLM 任务路由中的可行性与效率优势：以端到端分类器本身作为任务感知候选生成器（区别于 XMC 中嵌入检索或聚类派生短名单，以及路由候选 LLM 而非语义任务分类的工作），并将截断 top-k 教师分数的有效性边界与软标签蒸馏的"暗知识"理论及偏多标签学习联系起来。初步证据（Coverage@16 = 91–100%，服务器本地 ~5200 请求/s）支持"top-k 候选保留教师决策相关信息"这一中心假设，但完整评估（多 k 值覆盖率对照完整教师上界、嵌入检索基线、学生单独下界；足够大、人工审核、严格留出的测试集上的召回、一致率、准确率、延迟与成本对比）尚未完成，是后续修订的核心待回答问题。同时需报告与教师在 GPU 上全 60 类评分的等条件吞吐对比以给出标注成本下降比。

Abstract: Zero-shot classifiers are useful for routing user requests to specialized LLM tasks, but scoring every request against a large candidate set is expensive: a zero-shot NLI classifier must evaluate one premise-hypothesis pair per label, so cost scales linearly with taxonomy size. We study a student-guided teacher distillation pipeline for a fixed taxonomy of 60 LLM task categories: a compact ModernBERT classifier predicts the full category distribution in one forward pass and retrieves a small top-k candidate set, and a larger DeBERTa-v3 zero-shot NLI classifier reranks only those candidates rather than all 60 labels; the resulting teacher labels iteratively improve the student, which produces sharper candidates for the next round. Unlike generic embedding retrieval or clustering-derived shortlists used in extreme multi-label classification, our candidate generator is trained end-to-end on the target taxonomy and is the same model serving production traffic, distinguishing it from LLM-routing work that routes between candidate models, and from concurrent System-1 encoder-classifier proposals (e.g. TypeSafe AI's Jev and the open-source Laya project) whose training methodology is undocumented or RL-based. Our best student checkpoint reaches 77.5% teacher agreement on a 200-example evaluation set, and preliminary coverage measurements show Coverage@16 of 91-100%, suggesting top-k sets retain most of the teacher's decision-relevant information. We further show truncated top-k teacher scores should not be treated as full 60-class soft targets for KL distillation: zeroing untruncated classes destroys the dark knowledge soft-label distillation depends on, introducing systematic bias rather than a harmless sparse approximation. A complete evaluation, including coverage at multiple k on a held-out set, an embedding-retrieval baseline, and a larger human-reviewed test set, remains in progress.

</details>


### [240] [Instance-Dependent Regret for CMDPs with Step-Wise Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02520)
*Qian Zuo,Francesco Emanuele Stradi,Leyang Xue,Sattar Vakili*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SVAE算法,用于带逐步安全约束的表格CMDP在线学习,通过安全子图学习和方差自适应规划,获得关于回报方差和安全识别复杂度的实例依赖遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在带逐步安全约束的CMDP中,现有工作缺乏实例依赖的遗憾分析。安全约束诱导的安全子图会重塑可行策略的方差结构,但能否在未知安全子图下保留方差依赖学习的优势尚未明确,且安全识别本身具有独立于回报方差的统计难度。

Method: 提出SVAE算法,采用不对称设计:用方差无关的成本下置信界递归构建候选安全子图,同时在子图内进行方差自适应的乐观规划(使用经验奖励方差和经验转移方差作为探索奖励)。定义两类方差量(最大安全策略回报方差Var*和轨迹方差V_Σ)及安全识别复杂度C,刻画其对遗憾的影响。

Result: 在K回合内,以高概率达到遗憾界Õ(√(SAH·min{V_Σ,KVar*}) + S√(AH³·min{K,C}) + S²AH²);逐步违反界为Õ(H√(SAK)+S²AH²),在正成本间隔条件下违反界为Õ(SAH/Δ_c+S²AH²);当Var*=0时遗憾为K的多对数阶。下界表明对Var*和S*的依赖不可避免。实验验证了SVAE在随机导航中优于SUCBVI(强遗憾降低44.9%,违反降低7.7%)。

Conclusion: SVAE成功将方差依赖学习扩展到带逐步安全约束的CMDP,证明了安全约束既能降低回报方差(通过移除随机分支或减小后继值差异),又引入了独立于方差的安全识别复杂度。算法、遗憾界、违反界和下界共同刻画了此类问题的完整统计结构。

Abstract: We study online learning in episodic tabular constrained Markov decision processes with step-wise safety constraints. In such a setting, the constraints induce a safe subgraph that shapes the variance of cumulative rewards under feasible policies and, consequently, the difficulty of learning. Exploiting this structure, however, requires learning which actions are safe while controlling constraint violations. We propose Safe Variance-Adaptive Exploration (SVAE), an efficient algorithm that learns candidate safe subgraphs and performs variance-adaptive optimistic planning within them. With high probability, SVAE achieves cumulative regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{SAH\min\{\mathbb{V}_\Sigma,K\mathrm{Var}^{\star}\}}+S\sqrt{AH^3\min\{K,\mathcal{C}\}}+S^2AH^2)$ over $K$ episodes, where $H$ is the horizon of a single episode, while $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, respectively. Here, $\mathrm{Var}^{\star}$ is the maximum return variance among safe policies, $\mathbb{V}_\Sigma$ is the variance accumulated before the first unsafe action is encountered, and $\mathcal{C}$ captures the statistical complexity of eliminating actions incorrectly considered potentially safe. SVAE additionally attains $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(H\sqrt{SAK}+S^2AH^2)$ step-wise constraint violation and a gap-dependent violation bound that is polylogarithmic in $K$. Finally, we establish a lower bound showing that dependence on these instance-specific quantities is unavoidable.

</details>


### [241] [OpenGameEval: Benchmarking Agentic Programming and Exploration in a Stateful Game Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02563)
*Eray Turkel,Mengsha Sun,Kartik Ayyar,Sean Dunigan,Jack Lu,Vlad Shcherban,Hsiang-Shun Shih,Xin Wang,Tiantian Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OpenGameEval是Roblox Studio内面向智能体游戏开发的基准与评估框架，通过将观测工具与编辑工具分离的8工具动作空间，直接衡量探索行为。在84个人工策划任务上对13个前沿模型进行16次/任务的测试，发现：(1)最强模型单次通过率51.7%，5次中通过率仅39.4%，6个任务无任何模型解决；(2)性能相近的模型实际解决的任务集合差异巨大；(3)在执行前预先观测参考解所触及对象的运行通过率显著更高（场景类+13.4pp，脚本类+9.8pp）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体编码基准（如HumanEval、SWE-bench）主要评估最终任务成败，无法区分"理解系统的智能体"与"猜测的智能体"。在游戏开发等有状态环境中，智能体必须主动探索隐藏的引擎结构才能正确完成任务，而现有基准缺乏对探索行为的直接度量。

Method: 构建OpenGameEval评估框架，包含：(1)17个Roblox场景作为有状态世界，含113个评分任务（84核心+29调试）；(2)8工具动作空间，明确分为观测类（search_game_tree、script_read、script_grep、script_search、inspect_instance）和编辑类（multi_edit、execute_luau、insert_from_creator_store）；(3)双阶段验证——check_scene检查静态场景、check_game在模拟游戏会话中检查运行时行为；(4)每个任务标注参考解触及的实例与脚本作为依赖项；(5)用无偏U统计量估计pass@1/pass@5/cons@5/all@5，配对自助法比较模型，任务聚类的聚类稳健标准误估计轨迹效应。

Result: 13个前沿模型在84核心任务上的pass@1范围为36.7%-51.7%；排名前5的模型（Claude Fable 5、Gemini 3 Flash、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Gemini 3.5 Flash）整体pass@1相差仅1.1pp，但仅共同解决27/84任务，并集达58个。按工作类型拆分后，差异扩大至脚本编写类5.0pp、场景修改类12.5pp。在控制任务与模型的固定效应后，"在执行前先观测参考实例"在仅场景任务上+13.4pp（CI [+1.2, +25.7]），在仅脚本任务上+9.8pp（CI [+3.6, +16.0]）。该信号在加入（任务,模型）单元格固定效应后仍存在，且对仅脚本任务来说超越了通用探索量的解释力。

Conclusion: OpenGameEval证明：(1)在游戏引擎这种有状态环境中，前沿模型的平均通过率掩盖了它们截然不同的能力轮廓——它们解决的是不同的任务；(2)智能体的探索行为能够预测任务成败，特别是先于行动的对任务相关实例与脚本的观测；(3)该测量方案不限于游戏开发——任何能标注观测/动作工具及任务依赖的智能体评估均可采用。框架已以MIT协议开源（含任务套件、place文件、注释与编辑器插件）。

Abstract: We present OpenGameEval, a benchmark and evaluation framework for agentic game development inside Roblox Studio. It runs language models as agents in reproducible, stateful game-engine sessions and scores each run with executable checks, both on the edited scene and in a simulated play session. Most agentic coding benchmarks require exploration but score only final task success. OpenGameEval separates observation tools from editing tools in its eight-tool action space, so exploration can be measured directly. We measure the pass rates and exploration behavior of 13 frontier models on 84 human-curated core tasks, with 16 attempts per task. The tasks are hard for current models. The best model solves 51.7% of tasks on a single attempt and 39.4% five times out of five, and no tested model solves six of the tasks. Models at the frontier reach similar pass rates by solving different tasks: splitting tasks by the kind of work they require spreads the top five by 5.0pp on script-authoring tasks and 12.5pp on scene-change tasks. Exploration behavior predicts whether a run succeeds. Holding task and model fixed, a run that inspects every object a reference solution touches before acting on it passes 13.4pp more often than a run that inspects none of them on scene-only tasks, and 9.8pp more often on script-only tasks. We release the task suite, its place files, the per-task annotations, a plugin that runs the tasks inside Roblox Studio, and an updated leaderboard under the MIT license at this https URL .

</details>


### [242] [How Causality Bridges the Semantic Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02594)
*Shuhao Zhang,Xuran Zhou,Han Guo,Pengtao Xie,Yujia Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CausalBridge 框架，利用因果结构而非人类先验知识来弥合数值测量与变量语义之间的语义鸿沟。该方法从数据中自动发现因果图（含潜变量），然后在因果关系约束下求解未命名变量的语义嵌入，最后通过冻结的语言模型生成名称。在五个问卷和三个机器人场景上的实验表明，该方法在变量名称掩蔽 20-90% 的情况下均优于依赖关联的基线方法，且优势随文档化程度降低而扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当智能系统测量真实世界时，获得的是数值数据而非语义标签。许多变量虽有测量却无文档记录（如不同机器人平台的不同通道），还有些变量（如问卷调查中的潜在因子）从未被测量。现有方法依赖人类通用知识来推断语义，但会继承其偏见且在缺乏知识时无法工作。需要一种仅从数据本身恢复变量语义的方法，绕过人类知识的偏见和覆盖局限。

Method: 提出"结构约束语义对齐"任务并实现 CausalBridge 框架，分三步：(1) 因果结构学习——对纯观测变量使用 BOSS 搜索，对含潜变量场景使用 RLCD 从测量数据中发现因果图 Ĝ；(2) 受约束嵌入优化——将已命名变量的嵌入作为锚点，通过优化目标函数 Eq.3（包含生成项、边际独立性、边际依赖性和条件依赖性四项）求解未命名变量（包括潜变量）的嵌入向量，使嵌入间的余弦相似度反映因果图所蕴含的依赖/独立关系；(3) 前缀适配翻译——通过冻结语言模型的低秩更新，将每个未命名变量的嵌入向量作为前缀传入语言模型，并结合图中的邻域信息作为 prompt，由语言模型写出变量名称。

Result: 在五个问卷量表（DASS、HEXACO、KIMS、RIASEC、WVS）和三类机器人场景（6 个仿真机械臂、3 个真实机器人日志、10 次车辆 CAN 驾驶数据）上的实验表明：在 20-90% 名称掩蔽率下，CausalBridge 在命名准确性（NRR@1、识别率等指标）上全面优于 CLIP-Dissect、AutoInterp、Delphi、SASC 等基于关联的基线方法；在 50% 掩蔽率下，对未文档化车辆 CAN 的命名准确率比最强基线高 2.2 倍；在潜变量上，随掩蔽率从 20% 升至 75%，领先优势从 1.5 倍扩大到 1.9 倍；自动发现的因果图在命名准确性上与文档图相当；命名一个新系统仅需约 7 分钟（10 次驾驶），每变量仅用 458 个 token，比采样方法少用 2.6-56.6 倍 token。

Conclusion: 因果性可以弥合语义鸿沟：一旦少数变量被命名，其他变量的含义可从其因果关系（因、果、独立关系）中读取。这些关系源自数据生成机制，在读取任何名称之前即可恢复，而基于关联的方法则通过人类知识获得名称并继承其偏见。CausalBridge 的优势在文档化程度最低处最大，自动发现的图在命名准确性上与文档图相当。该工作主要局限在于仅在已知真名但被掩蔽的系统上评估，尚未应用于神经网络特征、科学数据潜变量等实际场景。

Abstract: Numerical measurements capture how a system behaves, but often leave the meanings of its variables unspecified. Some variables are measured but never labeled, and others are never measured at all. Existing methods assign semantics to such variables by consulting general human knowledge, but this inherits its biases where that knowledge exists and offers nothing where it does not. We bridge this gap between measurements and their meanings with causal structure instead, reading a variable's semantics from how it acts on other variables. We formalize this as structure-constrained semantic alignment, in which the embedding of each unnamed variable is solved under the dependence relations implied by the causal graph, with the embeddings of a few known names as anchors. Accordingly, we build CausalBridge, a framework that discovers the causal graph from the measurements, latent variables included, solves for the embeddings under those relations, and expresses them as names through a language model. The causal structure reflects the mechanism that generated the measurements and is recovered from the measurements alone, which may make it the one source of information free of bias from human knowledge. We evaluate CausalBridge on five questionnaires and three robotics scenarios, with 20 to 90% of the variable names masked. It recovers the semantics of observed and latent variables more accurately than existing methods that rely on association, and its lead widens as less of the system is documented. The graph it discovers names variables as accurately as the documented one, and a new system is named in minutes and at a fraction of the cost of sampling methods. Once the semantic gap is bridged faithfully, machines can understand the world and take actions causally.

</details>


### [243] [Distributed Learning with Selective State Space Models: Architecture-Aware Convergence Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02659)
*Adam Piaseczny,Md Kamran Chowdhury Shisher,Shiqiang Wang,Christopher G. Brinton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对选择性状态空间模型（如Mamba2）在联邦/分布式学习中的收敛行为进行了架构感知（architecture-aware）的理论分析，推导出架构特定的梯度范数界和平滑度界，并据此建立FedAvg与FedProx的收敛上界；同时在合成序列与Mamba2语言建模实验上进行了数值验证与九种联邦算法的比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的联邦学习方法大多是架构无关的，没有考虑选择性SSM的循环稳定性、选择性参数化以及状态空间结构。本文旨在填补这一空白，推导出将SSM的内在结构参数与联邦优化行为显式联系起来的收敛界。

Method: 为单层与多层选择性SSM推导梯度范数上界与局部平滑度常数（依赖于循环稳定因子ρ、参数包络及输入依赖离散化），并以此为基础，借助标准FedAvg/FedProx收敛框架，建立架构感知的收敛上界（包含ρ、参数范数、局部步数E、异质性TV距离等）。实验部分用教师SSM生成的合成序列验证界的一致性，并在六类RedPajama文本域上对Mamba2进行九种联邦学习算法的横向比较。

Result: 合成实验在141万余次界评估中无违反，验证了界的正确性；Mamba2实验显示FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedDyn在异质性β=1时较FedAvg分别提升约34%、19%和34%；理论期望与观测的Pearson相关达0.71（β=1时0.81），13/16的方向性预测符合。

Conclusion: 本文为选择性SSM的分布式学习提供了首个架构感知的收敛理论，并通过数值与语言建模实验验证了其解释能力；理论结果与SSM特定的循环稳定性、参数投影范数和客户端异质性密切相关，可为后续算法设计与超参选择提供指导。

Abstract: Modern state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba2, provide a compelling alternative to transformers by combining linear-time sequence modeling with recurrent state-space dynamics. However, the behavior of SSMs in distributed learning settings remains poorly understood. In particular, the existing standard federated learning methods are largely architecture-agnostic, and do not account for the stability, selectivity, and state-space parameterization that characterize modern selective SSMs. To address this, we derive architecture-aware gradient and smoothness bounds for single- and multi-layer selective SSMs, and convergence bounds for FedAvg and FedProx, characterizing how recurrent stability, input-dependent discretization, and state projection norms affect federated optimization. We then numerically validate the single-layer bounds on sequences generated by a teacher SSM, using a learner that follows the analyzed recurrence. We use this analysis to formulate expectations about the effects of local training and client heterogeneity, and examine these expectations by comparing nine federated learning algorithms on Mamba2 language modeling across six text domains. These experiments illustrate how SSM-specific bounds can provide a basis for interpreting the behavior of practical federated learning algorithms.

</details>


### [244] [LEAP: Learning Efficient Action Proposals For LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02670)
*Zhen Xu,Qizheng Zhang,Gerry Wan,Shang Zhu,Ce Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LEAP通过训练一个0.6B的小型草稿模型来预测冻结目标模型的规范化动作，在保持每个提交动作均由目标验证通过的前提下，使LLM智能体的端到端推理速度提升最高达60%。论文还提出了一个延迟分析框架，量化接受率、提议成本和验证等待对整体加速的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的逐步决策过程使其推理速度缓慢。已有的动作级推测方法使用现成大模型（准确但慢）或不微调的小模型（快但不准确），但缺乏对端到端加速决定因素的统一理解。本文旨在回答：动作推测中端到端加速究竟由什么决定。

Method: 1. 延迟分析框架：将端到端加速S建模为S≃c(1+fτ)/(β+D+gτ)，其中c为每轮提交步数，β为验证等待膨胀因子，D为提议成本，τ为工具相对成本，f/g为工具执行占比。2. LEAP训练方法：用目标自身的轨迹对小型草稿模型进行LoRA微调，仅用交叉熵拟合规范化动作（不含推理文本），草稿在推理时禁用思维链。3. 在线训练：利用运行系统中目标验证通过的提交动作作为监督信号，无需预先收集轨迹。

Result: 在四个基准（OpenAGI、TaskBench、τ²-bench、BFCL多轮）上，使用Qwen3-32B和Gemma-4-31B两个目标模型：0.6B草稿实现1.10-1.63×整体加速；任务成功率无系统性变化（28次比较中8次上升/8次下降/12次持平，差异≤3个任务）；框架预测在21个配置中19个误差≤0.10；在线训练最终适配器性能与离线训练相当（OpenAGI 1.47× vs 1.51×，τ²-bench 1.61× vs 1.61×）；草稿规模并非越大越好——在规划任务上4B草稿因成本增加而劣于1.7B。

Conclusion: 动作推测的端到端加速取决于草稿接受率与提议成本的平衡，而非单纯的接受率。LEAP通过训练小型草稿在冻结目标动作序列上达到此平衡，实现60%加速而无需牺牲任务正确性。框架解释了不同基准和草稿规模下加速差异的来源，为实际部署提供了配置指导（推荐0.6B草稿配合k=1作为起点）。局限：速度提升以目标计算量为代价（τ²-bench上生成1.16×的token），且推测会改变整体轨迹。

Abstract: LLM agents are known to be slow in rollouts. An agent completes a task one step at a time. At each step, it reasons and then chooses an action to execute. The next step and action cannot start until the previous one has finished. Speculative decoding accelerates the rollouts at the reason phase by drafting and verifying the inference tokens. Recent works have also started to apply similar ideas at the action phase. These works use off-the-shelf models, usually large, to draft action proposals for target model to verify. Large drafters match the target more often but take longer to propose, while small off-the-shelf models are fast but rarely make the same decision as the target. We ask a more general question: what determines the end-to-end speedup of action speculation? To answer it, we develop a latency framework for the speculative round. The framework compares what a round gains with what it costs. The gain depends on how well the drafter predicts the target and on how many steps the task can take before it ends. The cost comes from drafting, from waiting for target verification and from executing tools. Guided by the framework, we introduce LEAP (Learning Efficient Action Proposals) which keeps the drafter small and makes it accurate by training it on the target actions sequences. With a small 0.6B model, LEAP agrees with the target on most decisions and makes agents up to 60% faster in end-to-end wall clock time, with no systematic change in task success. Across various datasets, target models and draft models, the framework accounts for most of the measured speedups. We also show the draft model can be online trained with no prior trace collection and match the performance of offline training, making LEAP practical to deploy in the real world.

</details>


### [245] [Test-time Calibration Learning for Large Language Model Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02695)
*Zizhuo Zhang,Xiong Peng,Jingwei Sun,Rong Yao,Shixiong Kai,Mingxuan Yuan,Bo Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TTCL（Test-Time Calibration Learning），一种无需标签的测试时校准学习框架，通过多次采样响应自监督地同时提升LLM的推理准确率和置信度校准，并在理论上有界逼近理想校准目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有校准学习方法依赖标注数据，难以在无标签的测试时场景中应用，且源域训练的校准在跨域迁移时表现不佳，亟需一种能在无标签目标任务上直接校准LLM置信度的方法。

Method: 对每个无标签问题采样G个响应，以多数投票答案作为正确性伪标签，以各答案的采样频率作为置信度目标。正确性奖励施加于推理与答案token，负Brier分数校准奖励施加于置信度token，两者通过分离的分组相对优势进行优化。引入目标缓存（target cache）以EMA方式冻结监督信号，缓解奖励黑客问题，使策略不至于坍缩到单一错误高置信并高置信答案。

Result: 在8个数学与事实问答基准上，TTCL使基础模型平均相对准确率提升+40.13%、ECE降低+70.80%；在math-to-factQA跨域设置下，对RLCR已校准模型再额外带来+20.35%准确率增益和−53.83% ECE；一致优于P(True)、Verbalization、Elicitation、BaseCal等无标签校准基线，且不损害ARC/GPQA/MMLU等通用能力。

Conclusion: TTCL证明了在无标签条件下直接进行测试时校准学习的可行性，理论上是理想校准目标的有界代理，为未见测试分布下的可靠置信度估计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Reliable large language models (LLMs) must not only produce accurate answers but also express confidence that faithfully reflects their probability of being correct. Such calibration is essential for identifying uncertain predictions and supporting reliable decision-making in real-world deployment. Recent studies incorporate calibration learning into reinforcement learning (RL), jointly optimizing answer correctness and verbalized confidence using ground-truth correctness supervision. However, their reliance on labeled data limits their applicability in practical test-time settings, where ground-truth labels are unavailable and calibration may need to adapt to newly encountered target tasks. To address this challenge, we propose Test-Time Calibration Learning (TTCL), a label-free framework that jointly adapts reasoning accuracy and verbalized confidence directly on unlabeled target-task data. Specifically, TTCL derives self-supervision signals for both correctness and calibration from multiple model-generated responses, enabling calibration learning at test time without ground-truth labels. Theoretical analysis further establishes TTCL as a bounded surrogate for the ideal calibration objective. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and factual question answering demonstrate that TTCL consistently improves both accuracy and calibration across diverse models and tasks. On base models, TTCL achieves an average relative accuracy improvement of +40.13% and an ECE reduction of +70.80% across eight benchmarks. Moreover, TTCL can further improve both accuracy and calibration for already calibrated models under domain shift, particularly when source-domain calibration transfers poorly to target tasks. In the math-to-factQA setting, TTCL achieves an average relative accuracy gain of +20.35% and reduces ECE by +53.83%. The source code is released at this https URL .

</details>


### [246] [MuonIO: Principled Norm-Aware Descent for Embedding Tables and Language Model Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02705)
*Linkai Ma,Xinyu Luo,Mengbo Wang,Ananth Grama,Petros Drineas,Brian Bullins*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MuonIO提出了一种统一的Muon风格优化器更新规则，用于语言模型中的输入嵌入表和输出语言模型头。它为嵌入表采用1→2算子范数（基于one-hot输入几何），为lm_head采用2→∞算子范数（基于softmax输出的全变差稳定性），两种范数通过转置恒等式统一为相同的逐向量归一化更新规则。实验表明，相比AdamW，MuonIO将I/O层优化器状态内存减少50%、更新FLOPs减少约46%，并在LLaMA预训练中改善了验证困惑度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的Muon优化器实现将输入嵌入层和输出语言模型头排除在其基于谱范数的理论更新之外，转而使用AdamW处理这些层。这一例外缺乏充分的理论解释，且AdamW为这些大型矩阵（V×d）维护两个优化器状态矩，造成显著的内存和计算开销。需要一个原理性的、范数感知的统一更新规则来处理这两个面向词表的层。

Method: 1) 为嵌入表E∈R^{d×V}采用1→2算子范数，对应one-hot查询的最大列范数；2) 为lm_head L∈R^{V×d}通过softmax雅可比矩阵的∞→1范数≤1以及全变差稳定性分析，证明2→∞范数是控制输出分布扰动的自然惩罚；3) 利用恒等式‖L‖_{2→∞}=‖L^T‖_{1→2}，将两个矩阵统一为行向表示V×d，应用相同的2→∞-惩罚更新；4) 算法1实现了该更新：对动量进行行归一化，并以λ‖G‖_{2→∞}^† √d为缩放因子，仅需一个动量缓冲区。

Result: 在C4语料上预训练60M/130M/1B LLaMA模型：MuonIO在所有规模上均获得最佳验证困惑度（60M: 28.366, 130M: 23.617, 1B: 14.374），优于Muon Tuned基线和Ember；梯度范数分析显示MuonIO更快地减小I/O层梯度；优化器状态内存减半（从2Vd降至Vd），更新FLOPs从13Vd降至7Vd+3V（约减少46%）；该方法还可扩展至Polar Express优化器。

Conclusion: MuonIO成功地为嵌入表和语言模型头提供了一个原理性的、范数感知的统一Muon风格更新，弥合了Muon理论与其实际实现之间的差距。该方法不仅降低了计算和内存成本，还在语言建模性能上取得了实质性提升，证明了针对每层类型的输入/输出几何特性定制优化器的有效性。

Abstract: The Muon optimizer derives its update rule for hidden linear layers by solving a local linearization of the loss penalized by the spectral norm, motivated by an RMS-stability argument for dense linear layers. Standard Muon implementations, however, exclude the input (embedding table) and output (language model head) layers from this principled treatment, for which they use AdamW instead. We present MuonIO, a single Muon-style update for both of these layers. For the language model head $\mathbf{L} \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times d}$, we motivate the use of the $2\to\infty$ operator norm, due to the Lipschitz continuity of the softmax output geometry, while for the embedding table $\mathbf{E} \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times V}$, we draw on the $1 \to 2$ operator norm, based on the one-hot input geometry identified by Bernstein & Newhouse (2025). The identity $\lVert\mathbf{L}\rVert_{2\to\infty}=\lVert\mathbf{L}^\top\rVert_{1\to2}$ then puts both matrices in the same vocabulary-oriented geometry: MuonIO applies a single normalized-vector rule, which appears as column normalization for $\mathbf{E}$ and row normalization for $\mathbf{L}$. Empirical evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, with MuonIO reducing I/O optimizer state memory by 50% and I/O update FLOPs by $\sim$46% compared to Muon for 1B LLaMA pretraining on C4, while also improving validation perplexity.

</details>


### [247] [Prospective Hindsight: Self-Calibrating Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Reality Gaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02740)
*Jiaxin Zhang,Xiangyu Peng,Qinglin Chen,Yu Li,Hiroaki Hayashi,Chien-Sheng Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Prospective Hindsight (PH)，一种自校准强化学习训练原则，通过比较智能体行动前的预期预测与事后评估之间的差距，对产生预测-现实失配的 rollout 样本进行梯度放大。该方法作为即插即用模块兼容 GRPO、在线策略蒸馏（OPD）及其组合，在单轮可验证任务和多轮个人助理任务上同时提升任务性能与校准性，并自动适应不同失败模式（单轮以过度自信失败为主，多轮以不自信成功为主）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代智能体强化学习完全依赖事后反馈信号，行动时智能体的前瞻信念对梯度不可见，导致两个产生相同结果的 rollout（自信成功与侥幸成功、自信失败与意外失败）获得相同更新。这一结构性盲区被称为"后见之明陷阱"，使得基于后见之明的方法虽能提升任务准确率，却无法解决过度自信问题。现有校准方法多在推理阶段或添加额外校准目标，存在能力-校准权衡。

Method: 核心方法包含三个组件：(1) 前瞻自评估器——通过特殊提示让同一策略 π_θ 生成关于行动结果的 ternion 评分 z_t ∈ {-1, 0, +1}，与验证器结果 y_t 共同形成四格校准分类（CS/OF/US/AF）；(2) 惊奇指标 ξ_t = 1[(z_t, y_t) ∈ {OF, US}] 标识预测-现实失配；(3) 惊奇加权更新规则 ℓ^PH = (1+α·ξ_t)·ℓ^base，仅一个超参数 α。理论上，通过全方差分解将结果方差分解为偶然噪声与特权信息差距 I*；通过塔法则得到精确恒等式 R(θ) = c(θ)·M(θ)，表明最小化惊奇残差同时驱动基础损失与失准率下降。预测器与策略共享参数，因此两者协同进化，惊奇权重随预测-现实差距闭合而自动衰减。

Result: 在 Science Q&A 与 Tool Use 单轮任务中，PH 在 SDPO 基线上同时提升任务准确率（mean@16）与显著降低过自信失败率（OFR 从 34.2% 降至 20.9%，α=0.5）。在多轮个人助理任务（OpenClaw-RL 框架，OLMo-3-7B-Instruct）上，PH 在 GRPO（平均分 +7.2）、OPD（+15.3）与组合方法上均同时提升能力与校准性，前瞻准确率达 87.8%。α=1.0 为跨方法跨尺度的稳健默认值。消融实验表明选择惊奇样本而非单纯增加梯度质量是收益来源；多轮中失准模式从过度自信失败翻转至不自信成功，同一规则均有效。

Conclusion: PH 将智能体前瞻信念与验证器回顾结果之间的差距转化为训练信号，使校准性作为优化的副产品而非额外目标出现，避免了能力-校准权衡。该原理与具体基线方法正交，理论连接 LUPI 框架，在单轮与多轮、长短视野任务上均一致有效，是构建能力与自校准联合优化智能体 RL 流水线的关键一步。未来方向包括独立表征自评估器质量、扩展至更长视野任务、利用更丰富的 PRM 信号、与推理时自校正方法组合等。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on purely retrospective training signals: credit is assigned only after observing environmental consequences, leaving the agent's belief at action time invisible to the gradient. We introduce Prospective Hindsight (PH), a self-calibrating training principle that augments any retrospective base method with a signal derived from the gap between the agent's prospective prediction (before feedback) and the retrospective evaluation (after feedback). This per-rollout surprise identifies samples where the agent's self-model is most inaccurate and amplifies their gradient contribution through a stop-gradient surprise-weighted advantage. Since the prospective predictor shares parameters with the policy, the two co-evolve, progressively shifting focus to the agent's remaining blind spots. We connect this principle to a privileged-information gap and show that minimizing the surprise residual provides a descent pathway on the agent's miscalibration rate; calibration thus emerges as a byproduct of optimization rather than from an added objective. On single-turn verifiable tasks and a multi-turn personal-agent task (under GRPO, on-policy distillation, and their combination), PH improves both task performance and calibration, with consistent gains across model scales. Notably, the dominant miscalibration mode shifts structurally between regimes, overconfident failures in single-turn, underconfident successes in multi-turn, yet the same training principle addresses both successfully.

</details>


### [248] [Nearly Optimal Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with 1-Bit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02771)
*Khang Luong,Dinh Thai Son,Hoang Ta,Hung The Tran,Tuan Quang Dam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究有限方差、1比特反馈约束下的固定置信度最优臂识别（BAI）。提出基于随机阈值查询和裁剪尾积分恒等式的时一致均值估计原语，并将其嵌入候选-挑战者BAI算法。固定裁剪算法提供任意时(ε,δ)-PAC保证，分相自适应裁剪算法给出与间隙自适应的样本复杂度。证明K臂最坏情况下界，表明有限方差1比特反馈导致的对数惩罚是内在的，与分相算法的领先依赖关系匹配（差log log因子）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典固定置信度BAI假设每次拉臂都能观测到奖励的真实值，从而可直接构造经验均值和置信区间。但在通信受限场景（如上行链路受限传感、定价拍卖）中，学习者只能获得1比特反馈（奖励是否属于查询集），且仅有有限方差假设（无界支撑），这使得直接均值估计不可用，并不可避免地需要裁剪。需要在这种严格反馈约束下设计高效且理论上严格的BAI算法。

Method: 方法分为三部分：(1) 1比特均值估计原语：利用裁剪尾积分恒等式将裁剪变量均值表示为阈值概率差的积分；通过从特定密度g_L随机采样阈值并进行符号随机化，设计无偏估计量；利用Bernstein不等式推导时一致置信序列（对所有n同时成立）。(2) BAI算法：基于候选-挑战者框架（类似UGapE）嵌入1比特估计量。FixedClip-1BitBAI使用与目标精度ε对应的固定裁剪级别；RestartPhasedClip-1BitBAI按几何递减分辨率分相，每相选择匹配当前分辨率的裁剪级别，并按间隙大小逐步淘汰臂。(3) 下界：构造多尺度硬分布对(P_0, P_+, P_-)，均值差为Δ，支撑点几何分布在J=Θ(log(σ/Δ))个尺度上，使任何1比特可测集查询的单查询KL散度有界为O(Δ²/(Jσ²))；通过K臂嵌入和变测度论证得到最坏情况下界。

Result: 主要理论结果：(1) 1比特均值估计量样本复杂度为O((σ²/β²)log(σ/β)[log(1/γ)+loglog(e+σ/β)])，匹配Lau-Scarlett最优率至log log因子。(2) FixedClip-1BitBAI是高概率O(H_fix(ε)[log(K/δ)+loglog H_fix(ε)])，其中H_fix(ε)含混合项σ²/(ε Δ̃_k)。(3) RestartPhasedClip-1BitBAI是高概率O(H_gap[log(K/δ)+loglog(σ/ε)])，其中H_gap=Σ(1+log(σ/Δ̄_k))σ²/Δ̄_k²。(4) 下界：任何δ-正确算法的期望停止时间≥c(K-1)(σ²/Δ²)log(σ/Δ)log(1/δ)，匹配分相算法领先依赖关系至log log因子。实验验证：1比特均值估计在Student-t和指数分布下MAE和偏差更小；分相算法在异质间隙实例上优于固定裁剪。

Conclusion: 本文建立了有限方差1比特反馈下固定置信度BAI的近乎最优框架。核心技术贡献是将Lau-Scarlett的1比特均值估计率适配为时一致置信序列，使其适用于自适应的候选-挑战者BAI算法。分相自适应裁剪策略消除了固定裁剪的混合惩罚项，实现了间隙自适应复杂度。最坏情况下界证明log(σ/Δ)惩罚是有限方差1比特反馈的固有代价。开放问题包括：(1) 去除定位假设；(2) 刻画精确的实例依赖复杂度；(3) 将时一致1比特原语推广到更广泛的纯探索任务。

Abstract: We study fixed-confidence best-arm identification under strict 1-bit feedback constraints. At each round, the learner selects an arm and a query set, and receives only a single bit indicating whether the sampled reward belongs to that set. We consider a distribution-free finite-variance setting with arm-wise localization, where direct empirical mean estimation is no longer available and clipping becomes unavoidable. We first formulate a time-uniform 1-bit mean-estimation primitive based on randomized threshold queries and a clipped tail-integral identity. We then embed this primitive into candidate-challenger best-arm identification algorithms. A fixed-clipping algorithm gives a simple anytime $(\epsilon,\delta)$-PAC guarantee, while a phased adaptive-clipping algorithm matches the clipping level to the current resolution and yields a gap-adaptive sample complexity. We also prove a $K$-arm worst-case information-theoretic lower bound showing that the logarithmic penalty caused by finite-variance 1-bit feedback is intrinsic. This bound matches the leading dependence of the phased algorithm up to lower-order $\log\log$ factors.

</details>


### [249] [OPD Before RL: Warm-Starting Rubric-Based RL with On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02781)
*Xinpeng Wang,Wei Shi,Yu-Chia Chen,Maria Zontak,Yun He,Richard Yuanzhe Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RP-OPD+Rubric-RL两阶段框架：先用评分标准作为特权信息进行on-policy蒸馏，再用评分标准作为奖励进行强化学习，解决开放任务中奖励信号稀疏的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习虽然适用于开放性任务，但只能提供稀疏的轨迹级奖励，缺乏token级信用分配信号，导致训练效率低且易出现reward hacking。

Method: 两阶段训练：(1) RP-OPD阶段——学生模型在无评分标准条件下生成文本，评分标准感知的教师模型在特权信息下提供top-K token级分布，学生通过forward KL进行蒸馏；(2) Rubric-RL阶段——以蒸馏后checkpoint初始化，使用GRPO直接优化评分标准奖励。

Result: 在HealthBench、ResearchQA、RubricHub Science三个基准上，使用Qwen2.5和Llama系列模型，RP-OPD+Rubric-RL在所有模型-数据集组合上均取得最高分；比SFT+RL保留更高token熵和更强后续RL增益；SFT+RL在RubricHub Science上出现严重reward hacking（声称满足评分标准但无实质内容），regrading后分数从0.830降至0.404。

Conclusion: 使用评分标准引导on-policy蒸馏作为基于评分标准RL的预热阶段，比传统SFT预热更优，能更好地保留模型可塑性、获得更高下游RL收益，并显著减少reward hacking。

Abstract: Many useful language-model tasks cannot be evaluated by exact outcome verification. Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) addresses this issue by scoring open-ended responses against explicit criteria. However, because the reward is assigned after the complete response, the training signal does not directly identify which individual decisions contributed to the final score. We propose a two-stage training framework that uses rubrics first as privileged teacher context for dense token-level supervision, then as rewards for further RL. In the first stage, rubric-privileged on-policy distillation (RP-OPD), a student without access to the rubric matches a rubric-aware teacher's next-token distributions at student-generated prefixes. In the second stage, RL directly optimizes the rubric reward and improves beyond the observed distillation plateau. We evaluate the framework on health and science tasks using open-weight models. Across HealthBench, ResearchQA, and RubricHub Science, we compare post-training methods and vary the amount of SFT or RP-OPD training before RL, finding that our two-stage framework achieves the highest scores among the methods evaluated. RP-OPD + RL shows limited signs of reward hacking on RubricHub Science, whereas the SFT + RL baseline increasingly receives high rewards for claims of rubric compliance without providing the required content. These findings support using rubrics to guide on-policy distillation before applying rubric-based RL.

</details>


### [250] [Adaptive Spectral-Koopman Dynamics Modeling for Temporal Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02822)
*Tengxue Zhang,Yu Ke,Yang Shu,Chenchen Sun,Yisheng An,Chenjuan Guo,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaSpecK，一种结合谱滤波与Koopman算子的时序域泛化框架，通过潜空间谱正则化去噪和自适应上下文提取机制，在8个分类与回归基准上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序域泛化(TDG)需应对分布随时间漂移的流式数据。现有方法存在两大局限：数据空间建模易过拟合域特异性噪声；参数空间建模复杂且可解释性差。此外，非平稳性使得历史上下文难以有效利用。

Method: 1) 谱正则化Koopman动力学建模：在潜空间对域级表示做DFT，保留低频分量（比例β=0.40）去除噪声，再用Koopman算子在线性化空间建模演化，配合Koopman转移损失、重建损失和一致性损失。2) 上下文感知异构模式提取：目标条件注意力机制使每个未来步动态关注相关历史窗口；通过振幅与相位构造环境签名，经MLP路由器自适应选择K个专家进行模式聚合，并以语义正交损失防止专家坍缩。

Result: 在8个基准（5个分类：Rot-MNIST、Twitter、YearBook、ONP、Shuttle；3个回归：Cyclone、House、Appliance）上均超越Koodos、FreKoo等SOTA基线。例如Rot-MNIST错误率4.5%、YearBook 4.5%、Twitter AUC 0.74、Cyclone MAE 9.3。消融实验验证各模块与损失项均必要，决策边界可视化显示其能更好跟踪类别几何演化。

Conclusion: AdaSpecK通过谱滤波与Koopman动力学的结合有效缓解了噪声拟合问题，通过目标条件注意力与环境签名路由实现对非平稳历史上下文的自适应利用，在多种时序漂移场景下表现出强鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Temporal Domain Generalization (TDG) has emerged to address real-world streaming data with distribution shifts over time. However, existing methods are either prone to overfitting to domain-specific noise in the data space or become overly complex and less interpretable in the parameter space. To bridge these gaps, we propose \textbf{AdaSpecK}, a spectral-Koopman framework with adaptive context extraction for TDG. To mitigate noise fitting to irregularly sampled domains, we introduce spectral-regularized Koopman dynamics modeling, which applies spectral-aware filtering in the latent space to extract denoised low-frequency trajectories and learn a Koopman operator to model the system dynamics in a linearized space. To model complex historical environments under non-stationarity, we design a context-informed heterogeneous pattern extraction mechanism. Specifically, we employ a target-conditioned attention module to attend to distinct past windows, producing a dynamic, target-specific historical summary. By constructing an environmental signature from the current evolutionary pattern, our model adaptively perceives which aspects of the past context are most informative for future prediction via a learned router. Extensive experiments on eight diverse classification and regression benchmarks demonstrate that AdaSpecK achieves state-of-the-art performance. The code and datasets are available at \href{}{ this https URL }.

</details>


### [251] [Distributionally Robust Survival Models under Subpopulation Shift and Outlier Contamination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02868)
*Seonghwi Kim,Sung Ho Jo,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种耦合的分布鲁棒优化（CRO）框架，用于在潜在子群体偏移和异常值污染同时存在的情形下学习鲁棒的生存分析模型。该框架通过外部最小化（降低受污染样本影响、细化名义分布）与内部最大化（聚焦最具挑战性的子群体）的结合，直接处理非可分解的生存损失（如 Cox 负部分对数似然），保留风险集等跨样本交互。算法基于交替梯度法，外部更新利用内层优化的 KKT 乘子推导超梯度。模拟实验和 METABRIC、FLC 基准实验表明，该方法在子群体偏移和异常值污染同时出现时显著提升最差子群表现，同时保持有竞争力的整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在异质性人群中，平均表现良好的生存模型仍可能在某些子群体上表现不佳，且当训练数据受异常值污染时这一问题更加严重。现有的 f-DRO 框架（Hu & Chen, 2024）虽能改善对潜在子群体偏移的鲁棒性，但因强调高损失样本而对异常值高度敏感；而 DORO（Zhai et al., 2021）虽同时处理子群体偏移和异常值，但仅适用于可加损失，无法直接处理非可分解的生存损失。因此亟需一个能同时应对子群体偏移和异常值污染、并适用于非可分解生存损失的鲁棒框架。

Method: 提出耦合 DRO 框架：$\min_\theta [\min_{q' \in \mathcal{Q}_{1-\epsilon}(\bar{P})} \max_{q \in \mathcal{Q}_\alpha(q')} \mathbb{E}_q[\ell(Z,\theta)]]$。外层最小化通过 $\epsilon$-截断降低异常值影响，内层最大化对最高损失 $\alpha$ 比例样本加权（CVaR型）。对可加损失，可解析得到两阶段结构（截断+最坏情形加权）；对非可分解损失（如加权 Cox 负部分对数似然），开发交替梯度算法，外部更新通过内层问题的 KKT 乘子获得超梯度（Proposition 1 和 Theorem 2），并证明了局部收敛性（Theorem 3）。
